File: backend/prisma/migrations/20261107230000_ser_work_order_states_and_used_parts/migration.sql
================
-- Migración escrita a mano: conserva datos (Prisma generaba DROP/CREATE).

-- 1. WorkOrderStatus: PENDIENTE/EN_DIAGNOSTICO/EN_PROGRESO/CERRADA
--    → EN_DIAGNOSTICO/EN_PROCESO/ESPERA_REPUESTOS/CONCLUIDO
ALTER TABLE "work_orders" ALTER COLUMN "status" DROP DEFAULT;
CREATE TYPE "WorkOrderStatus_new" AS ENUM ('EN_DIAGNOSTICO', 'EN_PROCESO', 'ESPERA_REPUESTOS', 'CONCLUIDO');
ALTER TABLE "work_orders" ALTER COLUMN "status" TYPE "WorkOrderStatus_new" USING (
  CASE "status"::text
    WHEN 'PENDIENTE'   THEN 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO'
    WHEN 'EN_PROGRESO' THEN 'EN_PROCESO'
    WHEN 'CERRADA'     THEN 'CONCLUIDO'
    ELSE "status"::text
  END
)::"WorkOrderStatus_new";
DROP TYPE "WorkOrderStatus";
ALTER TYPE "WorkOrderStatus_new" RENAME TO "WorkOrderStatus";
ALTER TABLE "work_orders" ALTER COLUMN "status" SET DEFAULT 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO';

-- 2. Kilometraje de ingreso
ALTER TABLE "work_orders" ADD COLUMN "mileage" INTEGER;

-- 3. WorkOrderItem → UsedPart: renombrar tabla y objetos asociados
ALTER TABLE "work_order_items" RENAME TO "used_parts";
ALTER SEQUENCE "work_order_items_id_seq" RENAME TO "used_parts_id_seq";
ALTER TABLE "used_parts" RENAME CONSTRAINT "work_order_items_pkey" TO "used_parts_pkey";
ALTER TABLE "used_parts" RENAME CONSTRAINT "work_order_items_work_order_id_fkey" TO "used_parts_work_order_id_fkey";
ALTER TABLE "used_parts" RENAME CONSTRAINT "work_order_items_part_id_fkey" TO "used_parts_part_id_fkey";
ALTER INDEX "work_order_items_part_id_idx" RENAME TO "used_parts_part_id_idx";
ALTER INDEX "work_order_items_work_order_id_part_id_key" RENAME TO "used_parts_work_order_id_part_id_key";

File: backend/src/common/cors.ts
================
/**
 * Política de orígenes única para HTTP (main.ts) y Socket.io (led.gateway.ts).
 *
 * Permitidos:
 *  1. Orígenes exactos de CORS_ORIGIN (separados por coma), p. ej. el dominio
 *     de producción en Vercel: https://geartrace.vercel.app
 *  2. Túneles ngrok por SUFIJO de dominio y solo HTTPS (*.ngrok-free.app, ...).
 *  3. localhost y red privada (desarrollo / Raspberry Pi en LAN).
 *  4. Previews de Vercel (*.vercel.app) SOLO si CORS_ALLOW_VERCEL_PREVIEWS=true:
 *     cualquiera puede publicar en vercel.app, así que no se aceptan por defecto.
 *
 * Las variables se leen en cada llamada (no al importar), porque los
 * decoradores se evalúan antes de que ConfigModule cargue el .env.
 */

const NGROK_SUFFIXES = ['.ngrok-free.app', '.ngrok-free.dev', '.ngrok.app', '.ngrok.dev', '.ngrok.io'];

const LOCAL_HOSTNAMES = new Set(['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1', '[::1]', 'geartrace.local']);

const PRIVATE_NETWORK = [
  /^10\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}$/,
  /^192\.168\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}$/,
  /^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}$/,
];

/** Headers que el frontend envía (incluye el bypass de la advertencia de ngrok). */
export const CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS = [
  'Content-Type',
  'Authorization',
  'Accept',
  'ngrok-skip-browser-warning',
];

const normalizeOrigin = (origin: string) => origin.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase();

function configuredOrigins(): string[] {
  return (process.env.CORS_ORIGIN ?? '').split(',').map(normalizeOrigin).filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * `undefined` = petición sin header Origin (Alexa, curl, servidor a servidor):
 * se permite; CORS solo protege a navegadores y la API exige JWT igualmente.
 */
export function isAllowedOrigin(origin: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (!origin) return true;

  const normalized = normalizeOrigin(origin);
  if (configuredOrigins().includes(normalized)) return true;

  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(normalized);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  const { protocol, hostname } = url;
  if (protocol !== 'https:' && protocol !== 'http:') return false;

  if (protocol === 'https:' && NGROK_SUFFIXES.some((suffix) => hostname.endsWith(suffix))) {
    return true;
  }
  if (LOCAL_HOSTNAMES.has(hostname) || PRIVATE_NETWORK.some((range) => range.test(hostname))) {
    return true;
  }
  return (
    process.env.CORS_ALLOW_VERCEL_PREVIEWS === 'true' &&
    protocol === 'https:' &&
    hostname.endsWith('.vercel.app')
  );
}

/** Adaptador para la opción `origin` de `cors` / Socket.io. */
export function corsOriginCallback(
  origin: string | undefined,
  callback: (error: Error | null, allow?: boolean) => void,
): void {
  // Rechazo sin Error: se omiten las cabeceras CORS en lugar de responder 500.
  callback(null, isAllowedOrigin(origin));
}

================
File: backend/src/work-orders/work-order-number.ts
================
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

/** RF-SER-05: código correlativo por año, formato OT-YYYY-NNN (NNN crece a 4+ dígitos si hace falta). */
const PREFIX = 'OT';
const LOCK_KEY = 'geartrace:work_order_number';

export function formatWorkOrderNumber(year: number, sequence: number): string {
  return `${PREFIX}-${year}-${String(sequence).padStart(3, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * Calcula el siguiente código del año. DEBE ejecutarse dentro de la misma
 * transacción que crea la orden: el advisory lock serializa creaciones
 * concurrentes y se libera solo al confirmar o revertir.
 */
export async function nextWorkOrderNumber(
  tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  date: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<string> {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${LOCK_KEY}))`;

  // MAX numérico (no orden de texto): OT-2026-1000 debe ganar a OT-2026-999.
  const pattern = `^${PREFIX}-${year}-[0-9]+$`;
  const [row] = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ last: number | null }>>`
    SELECT MAX(CAST(split_part(number, '-', 3) AS INTEGER)) AS last
    FROM work_orders
    WHERE number ~ ${pattern}
  `;

  return formatWorkOrderNumber(year, (row?.last ?? 0) + 1);
}

================
File: backend/src/work-orders/work-order-scope.ts
================
import { Prisma, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';

/**
 * Órdenes visibles para el usuario autenticado:
 *  - GERENTE: todas.
 *  - MECANICO: solo las asignadas a él.
 *  - CLIENTE: solo las de sus vehículos.
 * Combinar siempre con el filtro propio de la consulta (`{ id, ...scope }`).
 */
export function workOrderScope(user: AuthenticatedUser): Prisma.WorkOrderWhereInput {
  switch (user.role) {
    case Role.GERENTE:
      return {};
    case Role.MECANICO:
      return { mechanicId: user.id };
    case Role.CLIENTE:
      return { vehicle: { ownerId: user.id } };
  }
}

================
File: frontend/src/api/socket.ts
================
import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';

const SOCKET_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_SOCKET_URL || 'http://localhost:3000').replace(/\/+$/, '');

/**
 * Conexión Socket.io al gateway de hardware (LEDs), apta para ngrok.
 *
 * - `transports: ['websocket']`: sin long-polling. Las peticiones XHR del
 *   polling pasan por la página de advertencia de ngrok y rompen el handshake.
 * - Sin `extraHeaders`: el navegador NO permite headers propios en el
 *   handshake WebSocket (solo se enviaban en polling), por eso no se usan.
 * - Reconexión con backoff acotado para sobrevivir reinicios del túnel o de la Pi.
 *
 * Quien la crea debe llamar a `socket.disconnect()` al desmontar.
 */
export function createHardwareSocket(): Socket {
  return io(SOCKET_URL, {
    transports: ['websocket'],
    reconnection: true,
    reconnectionDelay: 1000,
    reconnectionDelayMax: 10000,
    timeout: 10000,
  });
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/NewWorkOrderModal.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ClipboardPlus, Loader2, X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { usersApi, vehiclesApi, workOrdersApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { AppUser, CreateWorkOrderPayload, Vehicle, WorkOrder } from '../../api/types';
import { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

interface NewWorkOrderModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: (order: WorkOrder) => void;
}

interface FormState {
  vehicleId: string;
  description: string;
  mileage: string;
  estimatedCost: string;
  mechanicId: string;
}

const EMPTY_FORM: FormState = { vehicleId: '', description: '', mileage: '', estimatedCost: '', mechanicId: '' };

const fieldClass =
  'w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900/80 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-brand-500 disabled:opacity-50';

/** Formulario de nueva OT. El código OT-YYYY-NNN lo asigna el backend. */
export default function NewWorkOrderModal({ onClose, onCreated }: NewWorkOrderModalProps) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const isManager = user?.role === 'GERENTE';
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [vehicles, setVehicles] = useState<Vehicle[]>([]);
  const [mechanics, setMechanics] = useState<AppUser[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingOptions, setIsLoadingOptions] = useState(true);
  const [optionsError, setOptionsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [vehicleList, userList] = await Promise.all([
          vehiclesApi.list(),
          // Solo el GERENTE puede listar usuarios y asignar a otro mecánico.
          isManager ? usersApi.list() : Promise.resolve<AppUser[]>([]),
        ]);
        if (!active) return;
        setVehicles(vehicleList);
        setMechanics(userList.filter((item) => item.role === 'MECANICO' && item.isActive));
      } catch (error) {
        if (active) setOptionsError(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudieron cargar vehículos y mecánicos.'));
      } finally {
        if (active) setIsLoadingOptions(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isManager]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !isSaving) onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [isSaving, onClose]);

  const update = (field: keyof FormState, value: string) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));

  const validate = (): string | null => {
    if (!form.vehicleId) return 'Selecciona un vehículo.';
    if (!form.description.trim()) return 'Describe el motivo de ingreso.';
    if (form.mileage && (!Number.isInteger(Number(form.mileage)) || Number(form.mileage) < 0)) {
      return 'El kilometraje debe ser un número entero positivo.';
    }
    if (form.estimatedCost && (Number.isNaN(Number(form.estimatedCost)) || Number(form.estimatedCost) < 0)) {
      return 'El costo estimado debe ser un monto positivo.';
    }
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const validationError = validate();
    if (validationError) {
      toast.error(validationError);
      return;
    }

    const payload: CreateWorkOrderPayload = {
      vehicleId: Number(form.vehicleId),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      ...(form.mileage && { mileage: Number(form.mileage) }),
      ...(form.estimatedCost && { estimatedCost: Number(form.estimatedCost) }),
      ...(form.mechanicId && { mechanicId: Number(form.mechanicId) }),
    };

    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const order = await workOrdersApi.create(payload);
      toast.success(`Orden ${order.number} creada.`);
      onCreated(order);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo crear la orden.'));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
      onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && !isSaving && onClose()}
    >
      <form
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="new-work-order-title"
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full max-w-lg space-y-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/90 p-6 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl"
      >
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-2.5 text-brand-400">
              <ClipboardPlus size={20} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 id="new-work-order-title" className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Nueva orden de trabajo</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">El código OT-AAAA-NNN se asigna automáticamente.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar" className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </header>

        {optionsError && <p className="rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-300">{optionsError}</p>}

        <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
          Vehículo *
          <select
            autoFocus
            required
            disabled={isLoadingOptions}
            value={form.vehicleId}
            onChange={(event) => update('vehicleId', event.target.value)}
            className={fieldClass}
          >
            <option value="">{isLoadingOptions ? 'Cargando vehículos…' : 'Selecciona un vehículo'}</option>
            {vehicles.map((vehicle) => (
              <option key={vehicle.id} value={vehicle.id}>
                {vehicle.plate} · {vehicle.make} {vehicle.model}
                {vehicle.owner ? ` — ${vehicle.owner.name}` : ''}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
          Motivo de ingreso *
          <textarea
            required
            rows={3}
            maxLength={2000}
            value={form.description}
            onChange={(event) => update('description', event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Ej.: ruido al frenar, revisión de 10.000 km…"
            className={fieldClass}
          />
        </label>

        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
            Kilometraje
            <input
              type="number"
              min={0}
              step={1}
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={form.mileage}
              onChange={(event) => update('mileage', event.target.value)}
              placeholder="85400"
              className={fieldClass}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
            Costo estimado
            <input
              type="number"
              min={0}
              step="0.01"
              inputMode="decimal"
              value={form.estimatedCost}
              onChange={(event) => update('estimatedCost', event.target.value)}
              placeholder="0.00"
              className={fieldClass}
            />
          </label>
        </div>

        {isManager ? (
          <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
            Mecánico asignado
            <select
              disabled={isLoadingOptions}
              value={form.mechanicId}
              onChange={(event) => update('mechanicId', event.target.value)}
              className={fieldClass}
            >
              <option value="">Sin asignar</option>
              {mechanics.map((mechanic) => (
                <option key={mechanic.id} value={mechanic.id}>{mechanic.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">La orden quedará asignada a ti.</p>
        )}

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSaving}
            className="rounded-xl border border-slate-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700/50"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSaving || isLoadingOptions}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {isSaving && <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />}
            Crear orden
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/PartAutocomplete.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, KeyboardEvent, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Loader2, PackagePlus, Search, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { inventoryApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { InventoryPart } from '../../api/types';

const MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2;
const DEBOUNCE_MS = 250;

interface PartAutocompleteProps {
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Debe lanzar si falla, para conservar la selección y mostrar el error. */
  onAdd: (part: InventoryPart, quantity: number) => Promise<void>;
}

/** Buscador de piezas del inventario + cantidad para agregarlas a una OT. */
export default function PartAutocomplete({ disabled = false, onAdd }: PartAutocompleteProps) {
  const listboxId = useId();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState<InventoryPart[]>([]);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [searchError, setSearchError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<InventoryPart | null>(null);
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState('1');
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const latestRequest = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const term = query.trim();
    if (selected || term.length < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH) {
      latestRequest.current += 1;
      setResults([]);
      setIsSearching(false);
      setSearchError(null);
      return;
    }

    const requestId = ++latestRequest.current;
    setIsSearching(true);
    setSearchError(null);
    const timer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const parts = await inventoryApi.searchParts(term);
        if (requestId !== latestRequest.current) return; // respuesta obsoleta
        setResults(parts);
        setActiveIndex(parts.findIndex((part) => part.quantity > 0));
        setIsOpen(true);
      } catch (error) {
        if (requestId === latestRequest.current) {
          setSearchError(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo buscar en el inventario.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setIsSearching(false);
      }
    }, DEBOUNCE_MS);

    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query, selected]);

  const choose = (part: InventoryPart) => {
    if (part.quantity <= 0) return;
    setSelected(part);
    setQuery(`${part.name} (${part.code})`);
    setQuantity('1');
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const clearSelection = () => {
    setSelected(null);
    setQuery('');
    setQuantity('1');
  };

  const moveActive = (step: 1 | -1) => {
    if (results.length === 0) return;
    let next = activeIndex;
    for (let i = 0; i < results.length; i += 1) {
      next = (next + step + results.length) % results.length;
      if (results[next].quantity > 0) break;
    }
    setActiveIndex(next);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      event.preventDefault();
      moveActive(1);
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault();
      moveActive(-1);
    } else if (event.key === 'Enter' && activeIndex >= 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      choose(results[activeIndex]);
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.stopPropagation(); // cierra solo la lista, no el panel que la contiene
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const parsedQuantity = Number(quantity);
  const quantityError =
    selected && (!Number.isInteger(parsedQuantity) || parsedQuantity < 1)
      ? 'Ingresa una cantidad entera mayor a 0.'
      : selected && parsedQuantity > selected.quantity
        ? `Solo hay ${selected.quantity} en stock.`
        : null;

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!selected || quantityError) return;
    setIsAdding(true);
    try {
      await onAdd(selected, parsedQuantity);
      clearSelection();
    } catch {
      // El padre ya notificó el error; se conserva la selección para corregir.
    } finally {
      setIsAdding(false);
    }
  };

  const showList = isOpen && !selected && query.trim().length >= MIN_QUERY_LENGTH;

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search size={16} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500" />
        <input
          type="text"
          role="combobox"
          aria-expanded={showList}
          aria-controls={listboxId}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          aria-activedescendant={showList && activeIndex >= 0 ? `${listboxId}-${activeIndex}` : undefined}
          aria-label="Buscar repuesto por nombre o código"
          disabled={disabled || isAdding}
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => {
            if (selected) setSelected(null);
            setQuery(event.target.value);
          }}
          onFocus={() => results.length > 0 && setIsOpen(true)}
          onBlur={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder="Buscar repuesto por nombre o código…"
          className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900/80 py-2.5 pl-9 pr-9 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-brand-500 disabled:opacity-50"
        />
        {isSearching ? (
          <Loader2 size={16} className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-brand-400" />
        ) : (
          (query || selected) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={clearSelection}
              aria-label="Limpiar búsqueda"
              className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-white"
            >
              <X size={15} />
            </button>
          )
        )}

        {showList && (
          <ul
            id={listboxId}
            role="listbox"
            className="absolute z-20 mt-2 max-h-72 w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/95 p-1 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl"
          >
            {results.length === 0 ? (
              <li className="px-3 py-3 text-sm text-slate-400">Sin coincidencias en el inventario.</li>
            ) : (
              results.map((part, index) => {
                const outOfStock = part.quantity <= 0;
                return (
                  <li
                    key={part.id}
                    id={`${listboxId}-${index}`}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={index === activeIndex}
                    aria-disabled={outOfStock}
                    onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
                    onMouseEnter={() => !outOfStock && setActiveIndex(index)}
                    onClick={() => choose(part)}
                    className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm ${
                      outOfStock
                        ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
                        : index === activeIndex
                          ? 'cursor-pointer bg-brand-500/15 text-white'
                          : 'cursor-pointer text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700/50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="block truncate font-medium">{part.name}</span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {part.code}
                        {part.box && ` · ${part.box.name}`}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`shrink-0 text-xs font-medium ${
                        outOfStock ? 'text-red-400' : part.quantity <= part.minStock ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {outOfStock ? 'Sin stock' : `${part.quantity} disp.`}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                );
              })
            )}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>

      {searchError && <p className="text-xs text-red-400">{searchError}</p>}

      {selected && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 rounded-xl border border-brand-500/30 bg-brand-500/5 p-3">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
            Cantidad
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={selected.quantity}
              step={1}
              value={quantity}
              onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)}
              className="w-24 rounded-lg border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
            />
          </label>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isAdding || quantityError !== null}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {isAdding ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <PackagePlus size={16} />}
            Agregar a la OT
          </button>
          <p className={`w-full text-xs ${quantityError ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
            {quantityError ?? `Se descontará del inventario al agregar (stock actual: ${selected.quantity}).`}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/WorkOrderDetailPanel.tsx

import { ReactNode, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Car,
  CheckCircle2,
  ClipboardList,
  Gauge,
  Loader2,
  Package,
  Play,
  Save,
  Stethoscope,
  User,
  Wrench,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { workOrderActionsApi, workOrdersApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { InventoryPart, WorkOrder } from '../../api/types';
import { EMPTY, formatCurrency, formatDateTime } from '../../utils/format';
import { WORK_ORDER_STATUS } from '../../utils/status';
import StatusBadge from '../ui/StatusBadge';
import PartAutocomplete from './PartAutocomplete';
import { WORK_ORDER_TRANSITIONS } from './workOrderFlow';

interface WorkOrderDetailPanelProps {
  order: WorkOrder;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated: (order: WorkOrder) => void;
}

const kmFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('es');

function Section({ icon, title, children }: { icon: ReactNode; title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
      <h4 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
        <span className="text-brand-400">{icon}</span>
        {title}
      </h4>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function Field({ label, value }: { label: string; value: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-sm text-slate-200">{value}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Panel lateral con el detalle de una OT, su flujo de estados y los repuestos utilizados. */
export default function WorkOrderDetailPanel({ order, onClose, onUpdated }: WorkOrderDetailPanelProps) {
  const [diagnosis, setDiagnosis] = useState(order.diagnosis ?? '');
  const [finalCost, setFinalCost] = useState(order.estimatedCost ?? '');
  const [busyAction, setBusyAction] = useState<'status' | 'diagnosis' | 'conclude' | null>(null);

  const isConcluded = order.status === 'CONCLUIDO';
  const transition = WORK_ORDER_TRANSITIONS[order.status];
  const parts = order.parts ?? [];
  const totalUnits = parts.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const runAction = async (action: NonNullable<typeof busyAction>, task: () => Promise<WorkOrder>, success: string) => {
    setBusyAction(action);
    try {
      onUpdated(await task());
      toast.success(success);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo actualizar la orden.'));
    } finally {
      setBusyAction(null);
    }
  };

  const changeStatus = () => {
    if (!transition) return;
    void runAction(
      'status',
      () => workOrdersApi.update(order.id, { status: transition.to }),
      `Orden en "${WORK_ORDER_STATUS[transition.to].label}".`,
    );
  };

  const saveDiagnosis = () =>
    void runAction('diagnosis', () => workOrdersApi.update(order.id, { diagnosis: diagnosis.trim() }), 'Diagnóstico guardado.');

  const conclude = () => {
    const cost = finalCost === '' ? undefined : Number(finalCost);
    if (cost !== undefined && (Number.isNaN(cost) || cost < 0)) {
      toast.error('El costo final debe ser un monto positivo.');
      return;
    }
    if (!window.confirm(`¿Concluir la orden ${order.number}? Ya no podrá modificarse.`)) return;
    void runAction(
      'conclude',
      async () => {
        await workOrderActionsApi.conclude(order.id, cost);
        // /close responde sin mecánico ni factura: se recarga el detalle completo.
        return workOrdersApi.get(order.id);
      },
      `Orden ${order.number} concluida.`,
    );
  };

  /** Lanza en error para que el buscador conserve la selección. */
  const addPart = async (part: InventoryPart, quantity: number) => {
    try {
      onUpdated(await workOrderActionsApi.addUsedPart(order.id, { partId: part.id, quantity }));
      toast.success(`${quantity} × ${part.name} agregado(s); stock descontado.`);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo agregar el repuesto.'));
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 flex justify-end">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />

      <aside
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="work-order-detail-title"
        className="relative flex h-full w-full max-w-xl flex-col border-l border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/95 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl"
      >
        <header className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-700 p-5">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Orden de trabajo</p>
            <h3 id="work-order-detail-title" className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-white">{order.number}</h3>
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <StatusBadge {...WORK_ORDER_STATUS[order.status]} />
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Creada {formatDateTime(order.createdAt)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar detalle" className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white">
            <X size={22} />
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto p-5">
          {!isConcluded && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-brand-500/20 bg-brand-500/5 p-4">
              {transition && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={changeStatus}
                  disabled={busyAction !== null}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {busyAction === 'status' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <Play size={16} />}
                  {transition.label}
                </button>
              )}
              <div className="ml-auto flex items-end gap-2">
                <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Costo final
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    step="0.01"
                    value={finalCost}
                    onChange={(event) => setFinalCost(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0.00"
                    className="w-28 rounded-lg border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
                  />
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={conclude}
                  disabled={busyAction !== null}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/40 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {busyAction === 'conclude' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle2 size={16} />}
                  Concluir
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <Section icon={<Car size={16} />} title="Vehículo">
            {order.vehicle ? (
              <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <Field label="Placa" value={<span className="font-mono font-semibold text-white">{order.vehicle.plate}</span>} />
                <Field label="Marca / modelo" value={`${order.vehicle.make} ${order.vehicle.model}`} />
                <Field label="Año" value={order.vehicle.year ?? EMPTY} />
                <Field label="Color" value={order.vehicle.color ?? EMPTY} />
                <Field
                  label="Kilometraje de ingreso"
                  value={
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Gauge size={14} className="text-slate-500" />
                      {order.mileage === null ? EMPTY : `${kmFormatter.format(order.mileage)} km`}
                    </span>
                  }
                />
                <Field label="VIN" value={order.vehicle.vin ?? EMPTY} />
                <div className="col-span-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 p-3">
                  <User size={16} className="text-slate-500" />
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-200">{order.vehicle.owner?.name ?? EMPTY}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{order.vehicle.owner?.email}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </dl>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Sin datos del vehículo.</p>
            )}
          </Section>

          <Section icon={<ClipboardList size={16} />} title="Servicio">
            <p className="mb-3 whitespace-pre-line text-sm text-slate-200">{order.description}</p>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <Field
                label="Mecánico"
                value={
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Wrench size={14} className="text-slate-500" />
                    {order.mechanic?.name ?? 'Sin asignar'}
                  </span>
                }
              />
              <Field label="Iniciada" value={formatDateTime(order.startedAt)} />
              <Field label="Costo estimado" value={formatCurrency(order.estimatedCost)} />
              <Field label="Costo final" value={formatCurrency(order.finalCost)} />
              {isConcluded && <Field label="Concluida" value={formatDateTime(order.completedAt)} />}
            </dl>
          </Section>

          <Section icon={<Stethoscope size={16} />} title="Diagnóstico">
            {isConcluded ? (
              <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm text-slate-200">{order.diagnosis || 'Sin diagnóstico registrado.'}</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  value={diagnosis}
                  onChange={(event) => setDiagnosis(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Hallazgos técnicos de la revisión…"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900/80 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={saveDiagnosis}
                  disabled={busyAction !== null || diagnosis.trim() === (order.diagnosis ?? '').trim()}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700/50 disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                  {busyAction === 'diagnosis' ? <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" /> : <Save size={15} />}
                  Guardar diagnóstico
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </Section>

          <Section icon={<Package size={16} />} title="Repuestos utilizados">
            {parts.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-slate-400">Aún no se registran repuestos.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="mb-4 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-slate-700 text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-800 text-xs uppercase text-slate-400">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-semibold">Repuesto</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold">Cant.</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/70">
                    {parts.map((item) => (
                      <tr key={item.id} className="text-slate-300">
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <div className="text-slate-100">{item.part?.name ?? `Pieza #${item.partId}`}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{item.part?.code}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold text-white">{item.quantity}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                  <tfoot className="bg-slate-800/60 text-xs text-slate-400">
                    <tr>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2">{parts.length} repuesto(s)</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">{totalUnits} u.</td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}

            {isConcluded ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">La orden está concluida: no admite más repuestos.</p>
            ) : (
              <PartAutocomplete onAdd={addPart} />
            )}
          </Section>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/workOrderFlow.ts

import type { WorkOrderStatus } from '../../api/types';

/** Columnas del tablero en el orden del flujo SER. */
export const WORK_ORDER_COLUMNS: WorkOrderStatus[] = [
  'EN_DIAGNOSTICO',
  'EN_PROCESO',
  'ESPERA_REPUESTOS',
  'CONCLUIDO',
];

/**
 * Siguiente paso manual de cada estado. CONCLUIDO no aparece: solo se alcanza
 * con la acción "Concluir" (PATCH /service/work-orders/:id/close).
 */
export const WORK_ORDER_TRANSITIONS: Partial<
  Record<WorkOrderStatus, { to: Exclude<WorkOrderStatus, 'CONCLUIDO'>; label: string }>
> = {
  EN_DIAGNOSTICO: { to: 'EN_PROCESO', label: 'Iniciar trabajo' },
  EN_PROCESO: { to: 'ESPERA_REPUESTOS', label: 'Esperar repuestos' },
  ESPERA_REPUESTOS: { to: 'EN_PROCESO', label: 'Reanudar trabajo' },
};

File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/WorkOrdersList.tsx

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  AlertCircle,
  ClipboardList,
  Gauge,
  Package,
  Plus,
  RotateCw,
  Search,
  Wrench,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { workOrdersApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { WorkOrder, WorkOrderStatus } from '../../api/types';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/format';
import { WORK_ORDER_STATUS } from '../../utils/status';
import NewWorkOrderModal from './NewWorkOrderModal';
import WorkOrderDetailPanel from './WorkOrderDetailPanel';
import { WORK_ORDER_COLUMNS } from './workOrderFlow';

const columnAccent: Record<WorkOrderStatus, string> = {
  EN_DIAGNOSTICO: 'bg-sky-400',
  EN_PROCESO: 'bg-brand-500',
  ESPERA_REPUESTOS: 'bg-amber-400',
  CONCLUIDO: 'bg-emerald-400',
};

const kmFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('es');

function matchesFilter(order: WorkOrder, term: string): boolean {
  if (!term) return true;
  const haystack = [
    order.number,
    order.description,
    order.vehicle?.plate,
    order.vehicle?.make,
    order.vehicle?.model,
    order.vehicle?.owner?.name,
    order.mechanic?.name,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ')
    .toLowerCase();
  return haystack.includes(term);
}

function OrderCard({ order, onOpen }: { order: WorkOrder; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const partsCount = order.parts?.length ?? 0;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onOpen}
      className="group w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/70 p-4 text-left transition-colors hover:border-brand-500/50 hover:bg-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-500"
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <p className="font-bold text-white group-hover:text-brand-300">{order.number}</p>
          <p className="font-mono text-sm text-brand-400">{order.vehicle?.plate}</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-right text-xs text-slate-500">
          {order.vehicle?.make} {order.vehicle?.model}
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-slate-300">{order.description}</p>
      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 border-t border-slate-700/70 pt-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <Wrench size={13} /> {order.mechanic?.name ?? 'Sin asignar'}
        </span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <Package size={13} /> {partsCount}
        </span>
        {order.mileage !== null && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
            <Gauge size={13} /> {kmFormatter.format(order.mileage)} km
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="ml-auto">{formatDate(order.createdAt)}</span>
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * Tablero Kanban de órdenes de trabajo por estado, con alta de nuevas OT y
 * panel lateral de detalle (flujo de estados, diagnóstico y repuestos).
 * El backend limita al MECANICO a sus órdenes asignadas.
 */
export default function WorkOrdersList() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('');
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const latestRequest = useRef(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++latestRequest.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await workOrdersApi.list();
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setOrders(data);
    } catch (loadError) {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) {
        setError(getApiErrorMessage(loadError, 'No se pudieron cargar las órdenes de trabajo.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    return () => {
      latestRequest.current += 1;
    };
  }, [load]);

  const term = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      WORK_ORDER_COLUMNS.map((status) => ({
        status,
        orders: orders.filter((order) => order.status === status && matchesFilter(order, term)),
      })),
    [orders, term],
  );

  const selectedOrder = orders.find((order) => order.id === selectedId) ?? null;

  const upsertOrder = useCallback((updated: WorkOrder) => {
    setOrders((current) =>
      current.some((order) => order.id === updated.id)
        ? current.map((order) => (order.id === updated.id ? updated : order))
        : [updated, ...current],
    );
  }, []);

  const closeDetail = useCallback(() => setSelectedId(null), []);
  const closeCreate = useCallback(() => setIsCreating(false), []);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400">
            <ClipboardList size={24} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Órdenes de trabajo</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
              Flujo del taller por estado
              {!isLoading && !error && <span className="text-slate-500"> · {orders.length} órdenes</span>}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search size={16} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500" />
            <input
              type="search"
              value={filter}
              onChange={(event) => setFilter(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Filtrar por OT, placa, cliente…"
              aria-label="Filtrar órdenes"
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60 py-2.5 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 outline-none backdrop-blur-md focus:border-brand-500 sm:w-72"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsCreating(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(249,115,22,0.25)] hover:bg-brand-600 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-300"
          >
            <Plus size={18} /> Nueva Orden
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {error && !isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-10 text-center backdrop-blur-md">
          <AlertCircle className="text-red-400" size={28} />
          <p className="text-slate-300">{error}</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void load()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700/50"
          >
            <RotateCw size={16} /> Reintentar
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {columns.map(({ status, orders: columnOrders }) => (
            <div
              key={status}
              className="flex flex-col rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-4 backdrop-blur-md"
            >
              <h3 className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-slate-200">
                <span className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ${columnAccent[status]}`} />
                {WORK_ORDER_STATUS[status].label}
                <span className="ml-auto rounded-full bg-slate-700/60 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-slate-300">
                  {isLoading ? '…' : columnOrders.length}
                </span>
              </h3>

              <div className="space-y-3" aria-busy={isLoading}>
                {isLoading &&
                  Array.from({ length: 2 }, (_, index) => (
                    <div key={index} className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/50" />
                  ))}
                {!isLoading && columnOrders.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-4 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {term ? 'Sin coincidencias' : 'Sin órdenes'}
                  </p>
                )}
                {!isLoading &&
                  columnOrders.map((order) => (
                    <OrderCard key={order.id} order={order} onOpen={() => setSelectedId(order.id)} />
                  ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {isCreating && (
        <NewWorkOrderModal
          onClose={closeCreate}
          onCreated={(order) => {
            upsertOrder(order);
            setIsCreating(false);
            setSelectedId(order.id);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {selectedOrder && (
        <WorkOrderDetailPanel
          key={selectedOrder.id}
          order={selectedOrder}
          onClose={closeDetail}
          onUpdated={upsertOrder}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import { Module, forwardRef } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AlexaController } from './alexa.controller';
import { AlexaService } from './alexa.service';
import { InventoryModule } from '../inventory/inventory.module';
import { LedModule } from '../led/led.module';

@Module({
  imports: [
    InventoryModule,                  // Provee InventoryService
    forwardRef(() => LedModule),      // Provee LedGateway (forwardRef evita circular)
  ],
  controllers: [AlexaController],
  providers: [AlexaService],
  exports: [AlexaService],
})
export class AlexaModule {}

================
File: backend/src/alexa/alexa.types.ts
================
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Tipos TypeScript que mapean el JSON real que Amazon envía al webhook.
// Basado en la especificación oficial del Alexa Skills Kit (ASK).
// Referencia: https://developer.amazon.com/docs/custom-skills/request-and-response-json-reference.html
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** Estructura raíz de cualquier request que llega desde Alexa */
export interface AlexaRequestEnvelope {
  version: string;
  session?: AlexaSession;
  context: AlexaContext;
  request: AlexaRequest;
}

export interface AlexaSession {
  new: boolean;
  sessionId: string;
  application: { applicationId: string };
  user: { userId: string };
}

export interface AlexaContext {
  System: {
    application: { applicationId: string };
    user: { userId: string };
    device: { deviceId: string };
  };
}

/** Un request puede ser de tipo LaunchRequest, IntentRequest o SessionEndedRequest */
export type AlexaRequest =
  | AlexaLaunchRequest
  | AlexaIntentRequest
  | AlexaSessionEndedRequest;

export interface AlexaLaunchRequest {
  type: 'LaunchRequest';
  requestId: string;
  timestamp: string;
  locale: string;
}

export interface AlexaIntentRequest {
  type: 'IntentRequest';
  requestId: string;
  timestamp: string;
  locale: string;
  intent: AlexaIntent;
}

export interface AlexaSessionEndedRequest {
  type: 'SessionEndedRequest';
  requestId: string;
  timestamp: string;
  reason: 'USER_INITIATED' | 'ERROR' | 'EXCEEDED_MAX_REPROMPTS';
}

export interface AlexaIntent {
  name: string;
  confirmationStatus: 'NONE' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'DENIED';
  slots?: Record<string, AlexaSlot>;
}

export interface AlexaSlot {
  name: string;
  value?: string;        // El valor que el usuario pronunció
  confirmationStatus: 'NONE' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'DENIED';
  resolutions?: {
    resolutionsPerAuthority: Array<{
      authority: string;
      status: { code: 'ER_SUCCESS_MATCH' | 'ER_SUCCESS_NO_MATCH' | string };
      values?: Array<{ value: { name: string; id: string } }>;
    }>;
  };
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Tipos de RESPUESTA que GearTrace devuelve a Alexa
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface AlexaResponseEnvelope {
  version: '1.0';
  response: AlexaResponse;
}

export interface AlexaResponse {
  outputSpeech: AlexaOutputSpeech;
  card?: AlexaCard;
  shouldEndSession: boolean;
  reprompt?: { outputSpeech: AlexaOutputSpeech };
}

export interface AlexaOutputSpeech {
  type: 'PlainText' | 'SSML';
  text?: string;   // Para tipo PlainText
  ssml?: string;   // Para tipo SSML (permite control de pronunciación)
}

export interface AlexaCard {
  type: 'Simple' | 'Standard';
  title: string;
  text?: string;
  content?: string;
}

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Patch,
  Post,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { Roles } from '../auth/decorators/auth.decorators';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/guards/roles.guard';
import { AppointmentsService } from './appointments.service';
import { CreateAppointmentDto, UpdateAppointmentDto } from './dto/appointment.dto';

/**
 * /api/appointments — Agenda del taller (personal).
 * El CLIENTE agenda sus propias citas en POST /api/client/appointments.
 */
@Controller('appointments')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.GERENTE, Role.MECANICO)
export class AppointmentsController {
  constructor(private readonly appointmentsService: AppointmentsService) {}

  @Get()
  findAll() {
    return this.appointmentsService.findAll();
  }

  @Get(':id(\\d+)')
  findOne(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.appointmentsService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Post()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  create(@Body() dto: CreateAppointmentDto) {
    return this.appointmentsService.create(dto);
  }

  @Patch(':id(\\d+)')
  update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateAppointmentDto,
  ) {
    return this.appointmentsService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id(\\d+)')
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  remove(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.appointmentsService.remove(id);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/appointments/appointments.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { AppointmentStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateAppointmentDto, UpdateAppointmentDto } from './dto/appointment.dto';

const APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE = {
  vehicle: {
    include: { owner: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } },
  },
} as const;

const FINAL_STATUSES: AppointmentStatus[] = [
  AppointmentStatus.COMPLETADA,
  AppointmentStatus.CANCELADA,
];

@Injectable()
export class AppointmentsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.appointment.findMany({
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
      orderBy: { scheduledAt: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const appointment = await this.prisma.appointment.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
    });
    if (!appointment) throw new NotFoundException(`Cita con id ${id} no encontrada`);
    return appointment;
  }

  async create(dto: CreateAppointmentDto) {
    await this.ensureVehicle(dto.vehicleId);
    return this.prisma.appointment.create({
      data: {
        scheduledAt: this.toFutureDate(dto.scheduledAt),
        reason: dto.reason,
        vehicleId: dto.vehicleId,
      },
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateAppointmentDto) {
    const appointment = await this.findOne(id);
    if (FINAL_STATUSES.includes(appointment.status)) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una cita completada o cancelada no puede modificarse');
    }
    if (dto.vehicleId !== undefined) await this.ensureVehicle(dto.vehicleId);

    return this.prisma.appointment.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...dto,
        scheduledAt: dto.scheduledAt ? this.toFutureDate(dto.scheduledAt) : undefined,
      },
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    await this.findOne(id);
    await this.prisma.appointment.delete({ where: { id } });
  }

  private toFutureDate(value: string): Date {
    const date = new Date(value);
    if (date <= new Date()) {
      throw new BadRequestException('La cita debe agendarse para una fecha futura');
    }
    return date;
  }

  private async ensureVehicle(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.vehicle.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/decorators/auth.decorators.ts
================
import { SetMetadata } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';

export const ROLES_KEY = 'roles';

/**
 * Decorador @Roles() para declarar qué roles pueden acceder a un endpoint.
 *
 * Uso:
 *   @Roles(Role.GERENTE, Role.MECANICO)
 *   @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
 *   @Get('endpoint-protegido')
 *   getEndpoint() { ... }
 */
export const Roles = (...roles: Role[]) => SetMetadata(ROLES_KEY, roles);

/**
 * Decorador @CurrentUser() para extraer el usuario autenticado del request.
 *
 * Uso:
 *   getProfile(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) { ... }
 */
import { createParamDecorator, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';

export const CurrentUser = createParamDecorator(
  (_data: unknown, ctx: ExecutionContext) => {
    const request = ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    return request.user;
  },
);

File: backend/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts
================
import { Injectable, ExecutionContext, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';

/**
 * JwtAuthGuard
 *
 * Protege endpoints verificando el JWT en el header Authorization.
 * Si el token es inválido o no existe → 401 Unauthorized.
 *
 * Uso:
 *   @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
 *   @Get('perfil')
 *   getProfile() { ... }
 */
@Injectable()
export class JwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard('jwt') {
  override canActivate(context: ExecutionContext) {
    return super.canActivate(context);
  }

  override handleRequest<TUser>(err: Error, user: TUser): TUser {
    if (err || !user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        'Token inválido o expirado. Por favor, inicia sesión nuevamente.',
      );
    }
    return user;
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/guards/roles.guard.ts
================
import {
  Injectable,
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  ForbiddenException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { ROLES_KEY } from '../decorators/auth.decorators';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth.types';

/**
 * RolesGuard
 *
 * Verifica que el usuario autenticado tenga uno de los roles
 * declarados con @Roles() en el endpoint.
 *
 * IMPORTANTE: Siempre debe usarse DESPUÉS de JwtAuthGuard:
 *   @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
 *
 * Jerarquía de permisos GearTrace:
 *   GERENTE  → puede todo
 *   MECANICO → puede operar inventario y LEDs
 *   CLIENTE  → solo puede consultar
 */
@Injectable()
export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private reflector: Reflector) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    // Leer los roles requeridos del decorador @Roles()
    const requiredRoles = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<Role[]>(ROLES_KEY, [
      context.getHandler(),
      context.getClass(),
    ]);

    // Si el endpoint no tiene @Roles(), está abierto a todos los autenticados
    if (!requiredRoles || requiredRoles.length === 0) {
      return true;
    }

    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<{ user: AuthenticatedUser }>();
    const user = request.user;

    if (!user) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Usuario no autenticado');
    }

    // GERENTE siempre tiene acceso a todo
    if (user.role === Role.GERENTE) {
      return true;
    }

    // Verificar si el rol del usuario está en la lista de roles permitidos
    const hasRole = requiredRoles.includes(user.role);

    if (!hasRole) {
      throw new ForbiddenException(
        `Acceso denegado. Se requiere uno de los roles: ${requiredRoles.join(', ')}. Tu rol actual es: ${user.role}`,
      );
    }

    return true;
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts
================
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ExtractJwt, Strategy } from 'passport-jwt';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { JwtPayload, AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth.types';
import { UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';

/**
 * JwtStrategy
 *
 * Passport strategy para validar JWT en cada request.
 * El JWT se extrae del header: Authorization: Bearer <token>
 *
 * validate() se llama automáticamente en cada request protegido.
 * El valor retornado se asigna a req.user.
 */
@Injectable()
export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(JwtStrategy.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly config: ConfigService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {
    super({
      jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
      ignoreExpiration: false,
      secretOrKey: config.get<string>('JWT_SECRET', 'geartrace-dev-secret-change-in-production'),
    });
  }

  async validate(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<AuthenticatedUser> {
    // Verificar que el usuario sigue existiendo y activo en la BD
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: payload.sub },
      select: { id: true, email: true, role: true, name: true, isActive: true },
    });

    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      this.logger.warn(`Token válido pero usuario ${payload.sub} inactivo o eliminado`);
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Usuario no encontrado o inactivo');
    }

    // Este objeto estará disponible en req.user en todos los endpoints
    return {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      name: user.name,
    };
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/auth.module.ts
================
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtModule } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { PassportModule } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ConfigModule, ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { AuthController } from './auth.controller';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { JwtStrategy } from './strategies/jwt.strategy';

@Module({
  imports: [
    PassportModule.register({ defaultStrategy: 'jwt' }),

    // JWT con secret tomado del .env y expiración configurable
    JwtModule.registerAsync({
      imports: [ConfigModule],
      inject: [ConfigService],
      useFactory: (config: ConfigService) => ({
        secret: config.get<string>(
          'JWT_SECRET',
          'geartrace-dev-secret-change-in-production',
        ),
        signOptions: {
          expiresIn: config.get<string>('JWT_EXPIRES_IN', '8h'),
        },
      }),
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [AuthController],
  providers: [AuthService, JwtStrategy],
  exports: [JwtModule, PassportModule, AuthService],
})
export class AuthModule {}

import { Role } from '@prisma/client';

/**
 * Payload que se firma dentro del JWT.
 * Debe ser mínimo para no exponer datos sensibles.
 */
export interface JwtPayload {
  sub: number;    // User ID (estándar JWT)
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  name: string;
}

/**
 * Datos del usuario autenticado disponibles en los guards y decoradores.
 * Se adjunta en req.user por la JwtStrategy.
 */
export interface AuthenticatedUser {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  name: string;
}

File: backend/src/common/prisma-errors.ts

import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

/** P2002: violación de restricción única. P2003: violación de llave foránea. */
export type PrismaErrorCode = 'P2002' | 'P2003';

export function isPrismaError(error: unknown, code: PrismaErrorCode): boolean {
  return error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === code;
}

import { InvoiceStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import {
  IsEnum,
  IsInt,
  IsNumber,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  MaxLength,
  Min,
} from 'class-validator';

export class CreateInvoiceDto {
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(30)
  number: string;

  /** La orden debe estar CONCLUIDO y no tener factura previa */
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  workOrderId: number;

  /** Por defecto: dueño del vehículo de la orden */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  clientId?: number;

  /** Por defecto: finalCost (o estimatedCost) de la orden */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber({ maxDecimalPlaces: 2 })
  @Min(0)
  subtotal?: number;

  /** Monto de impuestos; por defecto 0. total = subtotal + tax */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber({ maxDecimalPlaces: 2 })
  @Min(0)
  tax?: number;
}

/** Solo facturas PENDIENTES pueden editarse; total se recalcula. */
export class UpdateInvoiceDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber({ maxDecimalPlaces: 2 })
  @Min(0)
  subtotal?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber({ maxDecimalPlaces: 2 })
  @Min(0)
  tax?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(InvoiceStatus)
  status?: InvoiceStatus;
}

@Controller('invoices')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.GERENTE)
export class InvoicesController {

    return this.invoicesService.findAll();
  }

    return this.invoicesService.findOne(id);
  }

  create(@Body() dto: CreateInvoiceDto) {
    return this.invoicesService.create(dto);

import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InvoiceStatus, Prisma, WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateInvoiceDto, UpdateInvoiceDto } from './dto/invoice.dto';

const INVOICE_INCLUDE = {
  client: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } },
  workOrder: { include: { vehicle: true } },
} as const;

@Injectable()
export class InvoicesService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.invoice.findMany({
      include: INVOICE_INCLUDE,
      orderBy: { issuedAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const invoice = await this.prisma.invoice.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: INVOICE_INCLUDE,
    });
    if (!invoice) throw new NotFoundException(`Factura con id ${id} no encontrada`);
    return invoice;
  }

  async create(dto: CreateInvoiceDto) {
    const order = await this.prisma.workOrder.findUnique({
      where: { id: dto.workOrderId },
      include: { vehicle: { select: { ownerId: true } }, invoice: { select: { id: true } } },
    });
    if (!order) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Orden de trabajo con id ${dto.workOrderId} no encontrada`);
    }
    if (order.status !== WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('Solo se pueden facturar órdenes de trabajo concluidas');
    }
    if (order.invoice) {
      throw new ConflictException('La orden de trabajo ya tiene una factura');
    }

    if (dto.clientId !== undefined) await this.ensureUser(dto.clientId);
    const clientId = dto.clientId ?? order.vehicle.ownerId;

    const subtotal =
      dto.subtotal !== undefined
        ? new Prisma.Decimal(dto.subtotal)
        : order.finalCost ?? order.estimatedCost;
    if (subtotal === null) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Indica el subtotal: la orden no tiene costo final ni estimado',
      );
    }
    const tax = new Prisma.Decimal(dto.tax ?? 0);

    try {
      return await this.prisma.invoice.create({
        data: {
          number: dto.number,
          workOrderId: dto.workOrderId,
          clientId,
          subtotal,
          tax,
          total: subtotal.plus(tax),
        },
        include: INVOICE_INCLUDE,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          `Ya existe una factura con el número "${dto.number}" o para esta orden`,
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateInvoiceDto) {
    const invoice = await this.findOne(id);
    if (invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.PAGADA) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una factura pagada no puede modificarse');
    }

    const subtotal =
      dto.subtotal !== undefined ? new Prisma.Decimal(dto.subtotal) : invoice.subtotal;
    const tax = dto.tax !== undefined ? new Prisma.Decimal(dto.tax) : invoice.tax;
    const isPaid = dto.status === InvoiceStatus.PAGADA;

    return this.prisma.invoice.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        subtotal,
        tax,
        total: subtotal.plus(tax),
        status: dto.status,
        paidAt: isPaid ? new Date() : undefined,
      },
      include: INVOICE_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    const invoice = await this.findOne(id);
    if (invoice.status === InvoiceStatus.PAGADA) {
      throw new ConflictException('No se puede eliminar una factura pagada');
    }
    await this.prisma.invoice.delete({ where: { id } });
  }

  private async ensureUser(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.user.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Cliente con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }
}

import { Injectable, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

@Injectable()
export class PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PrismaService.name);

  constructor() {
    super({
      log: [
        { emit: 'event', level: 'query' },
        { emit: 'stdout', level: 'info' },
        { emit: 'stdout', level: 'warn' },
        { emit: 'stdout', level: 'error' },
      ],
    });
  }

  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    await this.$connect();
    this.logger.log('✅ Conexión a PostgreSQL establecida');
  }

  async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
    await this.$disconnect();
    this.logger.log('🔌 Conexión a PostgreSQL cerrada');
  }
}

import { PurchaseOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { IsEnum, IsInt, IsOptional, IsString, MaxLength, Min } from 'class-validator';
import { CreatePurchaseOrderDto } from '../../supplier/dto/purchase-order.dto';

/**
 * Misma forma y validación que el pedido de reposición existente
 * (number, supplierId, items[{ partId, quantity, unitPrice? }]).
 */
export class CreatePurchaseDto extends CreatePurchaseOrderDto {}

/**
 * Solo pedidos PENDIENTES pueden editarse. Estado admitido: CANCELADA.
 * La recepción (RECIBIDA) incrementa stock y se hace en
 * POST /api/suppliers/purchase-orders/:id/receive.
 */
export class UpdatePurchaseDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(30)
  number?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  supplierId?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(PurchaseOrderStatus)
  status?: PurchaseOrderStatus;
}

File: backend/src/purchases/purchases.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PurchaseOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { SupplierService } from '../supplier/supplier.service';
import { CreatePurchaseDto, UpdatePurchaseDto } from './dto/purchase.dto';

const PURCHASE_INCLUDE = {
  supplier: true,
  items: { include: { part: true } },
} as const;

@Injectable()
export class PurchasesService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly supplierService: SupplierService,
  ) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.purchaseOrder.findMany({
      include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const order = await this.prisma.purchaseOrder.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Pedido con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return order;
  }

  /** Reutiliza las reglas de negocio existentes (piezas bajo stock mínimo). */
  create(dto: CreatePurchaseDto) {
    return this.supplierService.createPurchaseOrder(dto);
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdatePurchaseDto) {
    const order = await this.findOne(id);
    if (order.status !== PurchaseOrderStatus.PENDIENTE) {
      throw new ConflictException('Solo se pueden modificar pedidos pendientes');
    }
    if (dto.status === PurchaseOrderStatus.RECIBIDA) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Para recibir el pedido usa POST /api/suppliers/purchase-orders/:id/receive (actualiza stock)',
      );
    }
    if (dto.supplierId !== undefined) await this.ensureSupplier(dto.supplierId);

    try {
      return await this.prisma.purchaseOrder.update({
        where: { id },
        data: dto,
        include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
        throw new ConflictException(`Ya existe un pedido con el número "${dto.number}"`);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    const order = await this.findOne(id);
    if (order.status === PurchaseOrderStatus.RECIBIDA) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'No se puede eliminar un pedido recibido: ya incrementó el inventario',
      );
    }
    // Los PurchaseOrderItem se eliminan en cascada.
    await this.prisma.purchaseOrder.delete({ where: { id } });
  }

  private async ensureSupplier(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.supplier.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Proveedor con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }
}

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Patch,
  Post,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';
import { CurrentUser, Roles } from '../auth/decorators/auth.decorators';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/guards/roles.guard';
import { VehiclesService } from '../vehicles/vehicles.service';
import { WorkOrdersService } from '../work-orders/work-orders.service';
import { CreateVehicleDto, UpdateVehicleDto } from './dto/vehicle.dto';
import {
  CloseWorkOrderDto,
  CreateWorkOrderDto,
  DiagnoseWorkOrderDto,
  UpdateWorkOrderStatusDto,
} from './dto/work-order.dto';
import { ServiceService } from './service.service';

/**
 * Rutas legadas /api/service/* (las consume el frontend actual). Mantienen sus
 * paths, pero delegan en VehiclesService/WorkOrdersService para no duplicar
 * reglas (placa única, código OT-YYYY-NNN, alcance por mecánico).
 */
@Controller('service')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.MECANICO, Role.GERENTE)
export class ServiceController {
  constructor(
    private readonly serviceService: ServiceService,
    private readonly vehiclesService: VehiclesService,
    private readonly workOrdersService: WorkOrdersService,
  ) {}

  @Get('vehicles')
  findVehicles() {
    return this.vehiclesService.findAll();
  }

  @Get('vehicles/:id')
  findVehicle(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.vehiclesService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Post('vehicles')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  createVehicle(@Body() dto: CreateVehicleDto) {
    return this.vehiclesService.create(dto);
  }

  @Patch('vehicles/:id')
  updateVehicle(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateVehicleDto,
  ) {
    return this.vehiclesService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete('vehicles/:id')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  removeVehicle(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.vehiclesService.remove(id);
  }

  @Get('work-orders')
  findWorkOrders(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.workOrdersService.findAll(user);
  }

  @Post('work-orders')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  createWorkOrder(
    @Body() dto: CreateWorkOrderDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    return this.workOrdersService.create(dto, user);
  }

  @Patch('work-orders/:id/status')
  updateWorkOrderStatus(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateWorkOrderStatusDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    return this.serviceService.updateWorkOrderStatus(id, dto.status, user);
  }

  @Patch('work-orders/:id/diagnosis')
  diagnoseWorkOrder(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: DiagnoseWorkOrderDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    return this.serviceService.diagnoseWorkOrder(id, dto.diagnosis, user);
  }

  @Patch('work-orders/:id/close')
  closeWorkOrder(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: CloseWorkOrderDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    return this.serviceService.closeWorkOrder(id, dto.finalCost, user);
  }
}
