================
File: backend/src/service/service.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { workOrderScope } from '../work-orders/work-order-scope';

const WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE = { vehicle: true, parts: { include: { part: true } } } as const;

/**
 * Transiciones operativas de órdenes (estado, diagnóstico y cierre). El stock
 * se descuenta al agregar repuestos (WorkOrdersService, RF-INV-13). El CRUD de vehículos y la creación/listado de órdenes
 * viven en VehiclesService y WorkOrdersService; ServiceController delega en ellos.
 * Un MECANICO solo puede operar órdenes asignadas a él (workOrderScope).
 */
@Injectable()
export class ServiceService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async updateWorkOrderStatus(id: number, status: WorkOrderStatus, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findWorkOrder(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una orden concluida no puede cambiar de estado');
    }
    if (status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Para concluir la orden usa PATCH /api/service/work-orders/:id/close',
      );
    }
    return this.prisma.workOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status,
        // Solo la primera vez: reanudar desde ESPERA_REPUESTOS no reinicia la fecha.
        startedAt:
          status === WorkOrderStatus.EN_PROCESO && !order.startedAt ? new Date() : undefined,
      },
      include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async diagnoseWorkOrder(id: number, diagnosis: string, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findWorkOrder(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una orden concluida no puede modificarse');
    }
    return this.prisma.workOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { diagnosis, status: WorkOrderStatus.EN_DIAGNOSTICO },
      include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Concluye la orden (finalCost + completedAt). No toca inventario: por
   * RF-INV-13 cada UsedPart ya descontó stock al agregarse a la orden.
   */
  async closeWorkOrder(id: number, finalCost: number | undefined, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findWorkOrder(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('La orden de trabajo ya está concluida');
    }
    // Condición en el WHERE: si otra petición la concluyó entre medio, no se repite.
    const updated = await this.prisma.workOrder.updateMany({
      where: { id, status: { not: WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO } },
      data: { status: WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO, finalCost, completedAt: new Date() },
    });
    if (updated.count === 0) {
      throw new ConflictException('La orden de trabajo ya está concluida');
    }
    return this.prisma.workOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE });
  }

  /** Fuera del alcance del usuario responde 404 (no revela que existe). */
  private async findWorkOrder(id: number, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.prisma.workOrder.findFirst({
      where: { id, ...workOrderScope(user) },
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Orden de trabajo con id ${id} no encontrada`);
    return order;
  }
}

import { PartialType } from '@nestjs/mapped-types';
import { IsEmail, IsOptional, IsString, MaxLength } from 'class-validator';

export class CreateSupplierDto {
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(150)
  name: string;

  /** Identificador fiscal (RUC/NIT); único si se informa */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(50)
  taxId?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(150)
  contactName?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEmail({}, { message: 'El correo electrónico no es válido' })
  @MaxLength(255)
  email?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(50)
  phone?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(255)
  address?: string;
}

export class UpdateSupplierDto extends PartialType(CreateSupplierDto) {}

import { SuppliersService } from './suppliers.service';

 * /api/suppliers — CRUD de proveedores.

import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateSupplierDto, UpdateSupplierDto } from './dto/supplier.dto';

@Injectable()
export class SuppliersService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  /** Mantiene `_count.purchaseOrders`, usado por el frontend (SuppliersList). */
  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.supplier.findMany({
      include: { _count: { select: { purchaseOrders: true } } },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const supplier = await this.prisma.supplier.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { purchaseOrders: { orderBy: { orderedAt: 'desc' } } },
    });
    if (!supplier) throw new NotFoundException(`Proveedor con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return supplier;
  }

  async create(dto: CreateSupplierDto) {
    try {
      return await this.prisma.supplier.create({ data: dto });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicateTaxId(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateSupplierDto) {
    await this.ensureExists(id);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.supplier.update({ where: { id }, data: dto });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicateTaxId(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    await this.ensureExists(id);
    try {
      await this.prisma.supplier.delete({ where: { id } });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2003')) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'No se puede eliminar un proveedor con pedidos de compra registrados',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async ensureExists(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.supplier.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Proveedor con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }

  private throwDuplicateTaxId(error: unknown) {
    if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
      throw new ConflictException('El identificador fiscal ya está registrado');
    }
  }
}

import { PartialType } from '@nestjs/mapped-types';

import {

  IsEmail,

  IsString,
  MaxLength,
  MinLength,
} from 'class-validator';

export class CreateUserDto {
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(150)
  name: string;

  @IsEmail({}, { message: 'El correo electrónico no es válido' })
  @MaxLength(255)
  email: string;

  @IsString()
  @MinLength(6)
  @MaxLength(72) // límite de bcrypt
  password: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(Role, { message: 'El rol debe ser GERENTE, MECANICO o CLIENTE' })
  role?: Role;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsBoolean()
  isActive?: boolean;
}

export class UpdateUserDto extends PartialType(CreateUserDto) {}

import { UsersService } from './users.service';

@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.GERENTE)

  @Get()
  findAll() {
    return this.usersService.findAll();
  }

  findOne(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.usersService.findOne(id);
  }

    return this.usersService.create(dto);
  }

    return this.usersService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  remove(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    return this.usersService.remove(id, user.id);
  }
}

File: backend/src/users/users.service.ts
================
import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateUserDto, UpdateUserDto } from './dto/user.dto';

const BCRYPT_ROUNDS = 10;

/** Campos públicos: nunca se expone `password`. */
const USER_SELECT = {
  id: true,
  name: true,
  email: true,
  role: true,
  isActive: true,
  createdAt: true,
  updatedAt: true,
} satisfies Prisma.UserSelect;

@Injectable()
export class UsersService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.user.findMany({
      select: USER_SELECT,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: USER_SELECT,
    });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException(`Usuario con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return user;
  }

  async create(dto: CreateUserDto) {
    try {
      return await this.prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          ...dto,
          role: dto.role ?? Role.CLIENTE,
          password: await bcrypt.hash(dto.password, BCRYPT_ROUNDS),
        },
        select: USER_SELECT,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicateEmail(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateUserDto) {
    await this.findOne(id);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.user.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...dto,
          password: dto.password
            ? await bcrypt.hash(dto.password, BCRYPT_ROUNDS)
            : undefined,
        },
        select: USER_SELECT,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicateEmail(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async remove(id: number, currentUserId: number) {
    if (id === currentUserId) {
      throw new ConflictException('No puedes eliminar tu propio usuario');
    }
    await this.findOne(id);
    try {
      await this.prisma.user.delete({ where: { id } });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2003')) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'El usuario tiene vehículos o facturas asociadas; desactívalo en lugar de eliminarlo',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private throwDuplicateEmail(error: unknown) {
    if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
      throw new ConflictException('El correo electrónico ya está registrado');
    }
  }
}

import { PartialType } from '@nestjs/mapped-types';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';
import { IsInt, IsNotEmpty, IsOptional, IsString, Max, MaxLength, Min } from 'class-validator';

const toUpperTrimmed = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) =>
  typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().toUpperCase() : value;

export class CreateVehicleDto {
  /** Se normaliza a mayúsculas sin espacios externos ("abc-123 " → "ABC-123"). */
  @Transform(toUpperTrimmed)
  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  @MaxLength(20)
  plate: string;

  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(80)
  make: string;

  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(80)
  model: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1886)
  @Max(2100)
  year?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(toUpperTrimmed)
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(17)
  vin?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(50)
  color?: string;

  /** Cliente propietario del vehículo (rol CLIENTE, activo) */
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  ownerId: number;
}

export class UpdateVehicleDto extends PartialType(CreateVehicleDto) {}

File: backend/src/vehicles/vehicles.service.ts
================
import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateVehicleDto, UpdateVehicleDto } from './dto/vehicle.dto';

const OWNER_SELECT = { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } as const;

@Injectable()
export class VehiclesService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.vehicle.findMany({
      include: { owner: OWNER_SELECT },
      orderBy: { plate: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const vehicle = await this.prisma.vehicle.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        owner: OWNER_SELECT,
        workOrders: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } },
        appointments: { orderBy: { scheduledAt: 'desc' } },
      },
    });
    if (!vehicle) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return vehicle;
  }

  /** RF-SER-01: registra un vehículo validando que la placa no exista. */
  async create(dto: CreateVehicleDto) {
    await this.ensureOwner(dto.ownerId);
    await this.ensurePlateAvailable(dto.plate);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.vehicle.create({
        data: dto,
        include: { owner: OWNER_SELECT },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicate(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateVehicleDto) {
    await this.ensureExists(id);
    if (dto.ownerId !== undefined) await this.ensureOwner(dto.ownerId);
    if (dto.plate !== undefined) await this.ensurePlateAvailable(dto.plate, id);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.vehicle.update({
        where: { id },
        data: dto,
        include: { owner: OWNER_SELECT },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicate(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    await this.ensureExists(id);
    try {
      await this.prisma.vehicle.delete({ where: { id } });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2003')) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'No se puede eliminar un vehículo con órdenes o citas asociadas',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async ensureExists(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.vehicle.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }

  private async ensureOwner(id: number) {
    const owner = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: { role: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!owner) throw new NotFoundException(`Usuario con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    if (owner.role !== Role.CLIENTE || !owner.isActive) {
      throw new ConflictException('El propietario debe ser un cliente activo');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Comparación sin distinguir mayúsculas para cubrir placas antiguas no
   * normalizadas. El índice único de `plate` sigue cubriendo la concurrencia.
   */
  private async ensurePlateAvailable(plate: string, excludeId?: number) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.vehicle.findFirst({
      where: {
        plate: { equals: plate, mode: 'insensitive' },
        ...(excludeId !== undefined && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (existing) throw new ConflictException(`La placa "${plate}" ya está registrada`);
  }

  private throwDuplicate(error: unknown) {
    if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
      throw new ConflictException('La placa o VIN ya está registrado');
    }
  }
}

File: backend/src/work-orders/dto/work-order.dto.ts

import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import { WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import {
  IsArray,
  IsEnum,
  IsInt,
  IsNumber,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  Min,
  ValidateNested,
} from 'class-validator';

export class WorkOrderPartDto {
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  partId: number;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  quantity: number;
}

/** RF-INV-13: repuesto consumido que se agrega a una orden y descuenta stock. */
export class AddUsedPartDto extends WorkOrderPartDto {}

/**
 * El código `number` (OT-YYYY-NNN) lo genera el servidor (RF-SER-05); si el
 * cliente lo envía, la validación global lo rechaza (forbidNonWhitelisted).
 */
export class CreateWorkOrderDto {
  /** Motivo de ingreso / trabajo solicitado */
  @IsString()
  description: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber({ maxDecimalPlaces: 2 })
  @Min(0)
  estimatedCost?: number;

  /** Kilometraje del vehículo al ingresar */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  mileage?: number;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  vehicleId: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  mechanicId?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsArray()
  @ValidateNested({ each: true })
  @Type(() => WorkOrderPartDto)
  parts?: WorkOrderPartDto[];
}

/**
 * Edición general de la orden. El cierre (CONCLUIDO) no se permite aquí: usar
 * PATCH /api/service/work-orders/:id/close (registra finalCost y completedAt).
 * Los repuestos se agregan con POST /api/work-orders/:id/parts.
 */
export class UpdateWorkOrderDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  description?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  diagnosis?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber({ maxDecimalPlaces: 2 })
  @Min(0)
  estimatedCost?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  mileage?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  mechanicId?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(WorkOrderStatus)
  status?: WorkOrderStatus;
}

    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateWorkOrderDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,

  }

  @Delete(':id(\\d+)')
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  remove(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    return this.workOrdersService.remove(id, user);
  }
}

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { WorkOrdersController } from './work-orders.controller';
import { WorkOrdersService } from './work-orders.service';

  controllers: [WorkOrdersController],

================
File: backend/src/work-orders/work-orders.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  ForbiddenException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, Role, WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import {
  AddUsedPartDto,
  CreateWorkOrderDto,
  UpdateWorkOrderDto,
  WorkOrderPartDto,
} from './dto/work-order.dto';
import { nextWorkOrderNumber } from './work-order-number';
import { workOrderScope } from './work-order-scope';

const USER_SUMMARY = { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } as const;

const WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE = {
  vehicle: { include: { owner: USER_SUMMARY } },
  mechanic: USER_SUMMARY,
  parts: { include: { part: true } },
  invoice: true,
} as const;

/**
 * Fuente única de la lógica de órdenes de trabajo. También la usan las rutas
 * legadas /api/service/work-orders (GET y POST).
 */
@Injectable()
export class WorkOrdersService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  /** GERENTE ve todas; MECANICO solo las asignadas a él. */
  findAll(user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.prisma.workOrder.findMany({
      where: workOrderScope(user),
      include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  /** Una orden fuera del alcance del usuario responde 404 (no revela que existe). */
  async findOne(id: number, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.prisma.workOrder.findFirst({
      where: { id, ...workOrderScope(user) },
      include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Orden de trabajo con id ${id} no encontrada`);
    return order;
  }

  /**
   * RF-SER-05: el código OT-YYYY-NNN se genera en la misma transacción que la orden.
   * RF-INV-13: los repuestos iniciales descuentan stock en esa misma transacción;
   * si alguno no alcanza, no se crea nada.
   */
  async create(dto: CreateWorkOrderDto, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const mechanicId = this.resolveMechanicId(dto.mechanicId, user);
    await this.ensureVehicle(dto.vehicleId);
    if (mechanicId !== undefined) await this.ensureMechanic(mechanicId);
    if (dto.parts?.length) await this.ensureParts(dto.parts);

    try {
      return await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        const number = await nextWorkOrderNumber(tx);
        const order = await tx.workOrder.create({
          data: {
            number,
            description: dto.description,
            estimatedCost: dto.estimatedCost,
            mileage: dto.mileage,
            vehicleId: dto.vehicleId,
            mechanicId,
          },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        for (const { partId, quantity } of dto.parts ?? []) {
          await this.consumePart(tx, order.id, partId, quantity);
        }
        return tx.workOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({
          where: { id: order.id },
          include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
        });
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
        throw new ConflictException('No se pudo generar un código de orden único; intenta de nuevo');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateWorkOrderDto, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findOne(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una orden concluida no puede modificarse');
    }
    if (dto.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Para concluir la orden usa PATCH /api/service/work-orders/:id/close',
      );
    }
    if (dto.mechanicId !== undefined) {
      this.resolveMechanicId(dto.mechanicId, user);
      await this.ensureMechanic(dto.mechanicId);
    }

    const startsNow = dto.status === WorkOrderStatus.EN_PROCESO && !order.startedAt;

    return this.prisma.workOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { ...dto, startedAt: startsNow ? new Date() : undefined },
      include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  /**
   * RF-INV-13: agrega un repuesto consumido y descuenta `Part.quantity` en la
   * misma transacción. Si la pieza ya está en la orden, suma la cantidad.
   * Stock insuficiente → 409 y no se registra nada.
   */
  async addUsedPart(id: number, dto: AddUsedPartDto, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    await this.findOne(id, user); // alcance del usuario: orden ajena → 404

    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Bloquea la orden para que no se concluya mientras se agrega el repuesto.
      await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM work_orders WHERE id = ${id} FOR UPDATE`;
      const order = await tx.workOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id },
        select: { status: true },
      });
      if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
        throw new ConflictException('No se pueden agregar repuestos a una orden concluida');
      }

      await this.consumePart(tx, id, dto.partId, dto.quantity);

      return tx.workOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE });
    });
  }

  /** Una orden no concluida devuelve al inventario los repuestos que descontó. */
  async remove(id: number, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findOne(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('No se puede eliminar una orden concluida');
    }
    try {
      await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        for (const item of order.parts) {
          await tx.part.update({
            where: { id: item.partId },
            data: { quantity: { increment: item.quantity } },
          });
        }
        // Los UsedPart se eliminan en cascada.
        await tx.workOrder.delete({ where: { id } });
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2003')) {
        throw new ConflictException('La orden tiene una factura asociada');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * El GERENTE asigna a cualquier mecánico. Un MECANICO solo puede asignarse a
   * sí mismo y, si crea una orden sin indicar mecánico, queda asignado (si no,
   * no podría verla).
   */
  private resolveMechanicId(requested: number | undefined, user: AuthenticatedUser): number | undefined {
    if (user.role !== Role.MECANICO) return requested;
    if (requested !== undefined && requested !== user.id) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Un mecánico solo puede asignarse órdenes a sí mismo');
    }
    return user.id;
  }

  /**
   * Descuenta stock y registra el UsedPart. DEBE ejecutarse dentro de una
   * transacción. El `updateMany` condicionado a `quantity >= cantidad` es
   * atómico: dos consumos simultáneos nunca dejan el stock negativo.
   */
  private async consumePart(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    workOrderId: number,
    partId: number,
    quantity: number,
  ) {
    const updated = await tx.part.updateMany({
      where: { id: partId, quantity: { gte: quantity } },
      data: { quantity: { decrement: quantity } },
    });
    if (updated.count === 0) {
      const part = await tx.part.findUnique({
        where: { id: partId },
        select: { name: true, quantity: true },
      });
      if (!part) throw new NotFoundException(`Repuesto con id ${partId} no encontrado`);
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Stock insuficiente para "${part.name}": disponible ${part.quantity}, solicitado ${quantity}`,
      );
    }

    await tx.usedPart.upsert({
      where: { workOrderId_partId: { workOrderId, partId } },
      create: { workOrderId, partId, quantity },
      update: { quantity: { increment: quantity } },
    });
  }

  private async ensureVehicle(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.vehicle.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }

  private async ensureMechanic(id: number) {
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: { role: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException(`Mecánico con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    if (user.role === Role.CLIENTE || !user.isActive) {
      throw new ConflictException('El usuario asignado no es un mecánico activo');
    }
  }

  private async ensureParts(parts: WorkOrderPartDto[]) {
    const ids = [...new Set(parts.map((part) => part.partId))];
    if (ids.length !== parts.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Una pieza aparece repetida en la orden');
    }
    const count = await this.prisma.part.count({ where: { id: { in: ids } } });
    if (count !== ids.length) throw new NotFoundException('Una o más piezas no existen');
  }
}

================
File: frontend/src/api/crud.ts
================
import api from './axios';

/**
 * Cliente CRUD genérico para los recursos REST del backend.
 * El backend actualiza con PATCH (no PUT): `update` envía solo los campos modificados.
 */
export interface CrudApi<TEntity, TCreate, TUpdate> {
  list: () => Promise<TEntity[]>;
  get: (id: number) => Promise<TEntity>;
  create: (payload: TCreate) => Promise<TEntity>;
  update: (id: number, payload: TUpdate) => Promise<TEntity>;
  remove: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
}

/** @param resource Ruta relativa a /api, por ejemplo `/users`. */
export function createCrudApi<TEntity, TCreate, TUpdate = Partial<TCreate>>(
  resource: string,
): CrudApi<TEntity, TCreate, TUpdate> {
  return {
    list: async () => (await api.get<TEntity[]>(resource)).data,
    get: async (id) => (await api.get<TEntity>(`${resource}/${id}`)).data,
    create: async (payload) => (await api.post<TEntity>(resource, payload)).data,
    update: async (id, payload) =>
      (await api.patch<TEntity>(`${resource}/${id}`, payload)).data,
    remove: async (id) => {
      await api.delete(`${resource}/${id}`);
    },
  };
}

================
File: frontend/src/api/errors.ts
================
import { isAxiosError } from 'axios';

/** Extrae el mensaje de error de NestJS (string o arreglo de class-validator). */
export function getApiErrorMessage(error: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (isAxiosError<{ message?: string | string[] }>(error)) {
    const message = error.response?.data?.message;
    if (Array.isArray(message)) return message.join('. ');
    if (message) return message;
  }
  return fallback;
}

import api from './axios';
import { createCrudApi } from './crud';
import type {
  AddUsedPartPayload,
  AppUser,
  InventoryPart,
  Appointment,
  CreateAppointmentPayload,
  CreateInvoicePayload,
  CreatePurchasePayload,
  CreateSupplierPayload,
  CreateUserPayload,
  CreateVehiclePayload,
  CreateWorkOrderPayload,
  Invoice,
  PurchaseOrder,
  Supplier,
  UpdateAppointmentPayload,
  UpdateInvoicePayload,
  UpdatePurchasePayload,
  UpdateSupplierPayload,
  UpdateUserPayload,
  UpdateVehiclePayload,
  UpdateWorkOrderPayload,
  Vehicle,
  WorkOrder,
} from './types';

/**
 * Servicios por dominio. Roles exigidos por el backend:
 *  - users, invoices: GERENTE
 *  - vehicles, appointments, work-orders, suppliers, purchases: GERENTE, MECANICO
 *  - DELETE en todos: GERENTE
 */

export const usersApi = createCrudApi<AppUser, CreateUserPayload, UpdateUserPayload>('/users');

export const vehiclesApi = createCrudApi<Vehicle, CreateVehiclePayload, UpdateVehiclePayload>(
  '/vehicles',
);

export const appointmentsApi = createCrudApi<
  Appointment,
  CreateAppointmentPayload,
  UpdateAppointmentPayload
>('/appointments');

export const workOrdersApi = createCrudApi<
  WorkOrder,
  CreateWorkOrderPayload,
  UpdateWorkOrderPayload
>('/work-orders');

export const suppliersApi = createCrudApi<Supplier, CreateSupplierPayload, UpdateSupplierPayload>(
  '/suppliers',
);

export const purchasesApi = createCrudApi<
  PurchaseOrder,
  CreatePurchasePayload,
  UpdatePurchasePayload
>('/purchases');

export const invoicesApi = createCrudApi<Invoice, CreateInvoicePayload, UpdateInvoicePayload>(
  '/invoices',
);

/** Endpoints del CLIENTE autenticado (solo sus propios datos). */
export const clientApi = {
  myVehicles: async () => (await api.get<Vehicle[]>('/client/vehicles')).data,
  myWorkOrders: async () => (await api.get<WorkOrder[]>('/client/work-orders')).data,
  myAppointments: async () => (await api.get<Appointment[]>('/client/appointments')).data,
  createAppointment: async (payload: CreateAppointmentPayload) =>
    (await api.post<Appointment>('/client/appointments', payload)).data,
};

/** Búsqueda de piezas para autocompletar (nombre, código o palabra clave). */
export const inventoryApi = {
  searchParts: async (query: string) =>
    (await api.get<InventoryPart[]>(`/inventory/search/${encodeURIComponent(query)}`)).data,
};

/** Acciones operativas de una orden que no son CRUD. */
export const workOrderActionsApi = {
  /** RF-INV-13: registra el repuesto y descuenta stock en una transacción (409 si no alcanza). */
  addUsedPart: async (id: number, payload: AddUsedPartPayload) =>
    (await api.post<WorkOrder>(`/work-orders/${id}/parts`, payload)).data,
  /** Pasa la orden a CONCLUIDO; no toca inventario. Responde sin mecánico/factura: recargar con workOrdersApi.get. */
  conclude: async (id: number, finalCost?: number) =>
    (await api.patch<WorkOrder>(`/service/work-orders/${id}/close`, { finalCost })).data,
};

/** Transiciones que mueven inventario; viven en endpoints transaccionales dedicados. */
export const inventoryFlowsApi = {
  receivePurchase: async (id: number) =>
    (await api.post<PurchaseOrder>(`/suppliers/purchase-orders/${id}/receive`)).data,
};

import type { Role } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

/**
 * Tipos de las entidades que devuelve el backend (/api/*).
 * Los campos Decimal de Prisma llegan serializados como string.
 */

export type DecimalString = string;
export type ISODateString = string;

export type WorkOrderStatus = 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO' | 'EN_PROCESO' | 'ESPERA_REPUESTOS' | 'CONCLUIDO';
export type AppointmentStatus = 'AGENDADA' | 'CONFIRMADA' | 'COMPLETADA' | 'CANCELADA';
export type PurchaseOrderStatus = 'PENDIENTE' | 'RECIBIDA' | 'CANCELADA';
export type InvoiceStatus = 'PENDIENTE' | 'PAGADA';

export interface UserSummary {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
}

// ── Usuarios ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface AppUser extends UserSummary {
  role: Role;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: ISODateString;
  updatedAt: ISODateString;
}

export interface CreateUserPayload {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  role?: Role;
  isActive?: boolean;
}
export type UpdateUserPayload = Partial<CreateUserPayload>;

// ── Vehículos ───────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface Vehicle {
  id: number;
  plate: string;
  make: string;
  model: string;
  year: number | null;
  vin: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  ownerId: number;
  owner?: UserSummary;
  createdAt: ISODateString;
  updatedAt: ISODateString;
}

export interface CreateVehiclePayload {
  plate: string;
  make: string;
  model: string;
  year?: number;
  vin?: string;
  color?: string;
  ownerId: number;
}
export type UpdateVehiclePayload = Partial<CreateVehiclePayload>;

// ── Citas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface Appointment {
  id: number;
  scheduledAt: ISODateString;
  reason: string | null;
  status: AppointmentStatus;
  vehicleId: number;
  vehicle?: Vehicle;
  createdAt: ISODateString;
  updatedAt: ISODateString;
}

export interface CreateAppointmentPayload {
  scheduledAt: ISODateString;
  reason?: string;
  vehicleId: number;
}
export interface UpdateAppointmentPayload extends Partial<CreateAppointmentPayload> {
  status?: AppointmentStatus;
}

// ── Inventario ──────────────────────────────────────────────
/** Pieza devuelta por /inventory/search/:query (máx. 5 coincidencias). */
export interface InventoryPart {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  quantity: number;
  minStock: number;
  photoUrl: string | null;
  box?: { id: number; name: string; ledIndex: number; location?: string | null };
}

export interface AddUsedPartPayload {
  partId: number;
  quantity: number;
}

// ── Órdenes de trabajo ──────────────────────────────────────
/** Repuesto consumido en una orden (modelo UsedPart). */
export interface UsedPart {
  id: number;
  quantity: number;
  partId: number;
  part?: { id: number; name: string; code: string; quantity: number };
}

export interface WorkOrder {
  id: number;
  number: string;
  description: string;
  diagnosis: string | null;
  mileage: number | null;
  status: WorkOrderStatus;
  estimatedCost: DecimalString | null;
  finalCost: DecimalString | null;
  vehicleId: number;
  mechanicId: number | null;
  vehicle?: Vehicle;
  mechanic?: UserSummary | null;
  parts?: UsedPart[];
  invoice?: Invoice | null;
  createdAt: ISODateString;
  updatedAt: ISODateString;
  startedAt: ISODateString | null;
  completedAt: ISODateString | null;
}

/** `number` (OT-YYYY-NNN) lo genera el backend. */
export interface CreateWorkOrderPayload {
  description: string;
  estimatedCost?: number;
  mileage?: number;
  vehicleId: number;
  mechanicId?: number;
  parts?: { partId: number; quantity: number }[];
}

/** `CONCLUIDO` no se acepta aquí: el cierre usa /service/work-orders/:id/close. */
export interface UpdateWorkOrderPayload {
  description?: string;
  diagnosis?: string;
  estimatedCost?: number;
  mileage?: number;
  mechanicId?: number;
  status?: Exclude<WorkOrderStatus, 'CONCLUIDO'>;
}

// ── Proveedores ─────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface Supplier {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  taxId: string | null;
  contactName: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  address: string | null;
  _count?: { purchaseOrders: number };
  createdAt: ISODateString;
  updatedAt: ISODateString;
}

export interface CreateSupplierPayload {
  name: string;
  taxId?: string;
  contactName?: string;
  email?: string;
  phone?: string;
  address?: string;
}
export type UpdateSupplierPayload = Partial<CreateSupplierPayload>;

// ── Compras ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface PurchaseOrderItem {
  id: number;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: DecimalString | null;
  partId: number;
  part?: { id: number; name: string; code: string; quantity: number };
}

export interface PurchaseOrder {
  id: number;
  number: string;
  status: PurchaseOrderStatus;
  orderedAt: ISODateString;
  receivedAt: ISODateString | null;
  supplierId: number;
  supplier?: Supplier;
  items?: PurchaseOrderItem[];
  createdAt: ISODateString;
  updatedAt: ISODateString;
}

export interface CreatePurchasePayload {
  number: string;
  supplierId: number;
  items: { partId: number; quantity: number; unitPrice?: number }[];
}

/** `RECIBIDA` no se acepta aquí: la recepción usa /suppliers/purchase-orders/:id/receive. */
export interface UpdatePurchasePayload {
  number?: string;
  supplierId?: number;
  status?: Exclude<PurchaseOrderStatus, 'RECIBIDA'>;
}

// ── Facturas ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface Invoice {
  id: number;
  number: string;
  subtotal: DecimalString;
  tax: DecimalString;
  total: DecimalString;
  status: InvoiceStatus;
  issuedAt: ISODateString;
  paidAt: ISODateString | null;
  workOrderId: number;
  clientId: number;
  client?: UserSummary;
  workOrder?: WorkOrder;
  createdAt: ISODateString;
  updatedAt: ISODateString;
}

export interface CreateInvoicePayload {
  number: string;
  workOrderId: number;
  clientId?: number;
  subtotal?: number;
  tax?: number;
}

export interface UpdateInvoicePayload {
  subtotal?: number;
  tax?: number;
  status?: InvoiceStatus;
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Search, Plus, Package } from 'lucide-react';
import api from '../../api/axios';
import PartFormModal, { PartFormValues } from './PartFormModal';

interface InventoryPart {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  quantity: number;
  minStock: number;
  keywords: string[];
  box?: {
    id: number;
    name: string;
  };
}

const toFormValues = (part: InventoryPart): PartFormValues => ({
  id: part.id,
  name: part.name,
  code: part.code,
  quantity: part.quantity,
  boxId: part.box?.id ?? 0,
  minStock: part.minStock,
  keywords: part.keywords,
});

export default function InventoryList() {
  const [parts, setParts] = useState<InventoryPart[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPart, setSelectedPart] = useState<PartFormValues | null>(null);

  const loadParts = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await api.get<InventoryPart[]>('/inventory/parts');
      setParts(response.data);
      setError(null);
    } catch (requestError) {
      console.error('Error al cargar las piezas', requestError);
      setError('No se pudieron cargar las piezas.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadParts();
  }, []);

  const filteredParts = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!normalizedSearch) {
      return parts;
    }

    return parts.filter(
      (part) =>
        part.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
        part.code.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch),
    );
  }, [parts, search]);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400">
              <Package size={24} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Inventario</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
                Gestiona las piezas almacenadas.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setSelectedPart(null);
            setIsModalOpen(true);
          }}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-400 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-slate-900"
        >
          <Plus size={18} />
          Nueva Pieza
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-4">
        <label htmlFor="inventory-search" className="sr-only">
          Buscar piezas
        </label>
        <div className="relative">
          <Search
            size={18}
            className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
          />
          <input
            id="inventory-search"
            type="search"
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Buscar por nombre o código..."
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/70 py-2.5 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-100 outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:border-brand-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-500"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">Cargando piezas...</div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-red-400">{error}</div>
        ) : filteredParts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
            No se encontraron piezas.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] text-left text-sm">
              <thead className="border-b border-slate-700 bg-slate-800">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Pieza</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Código</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Caja</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Stock</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-slate-300">Acciones</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/70">
                {filteredParts.map((part) => (
                  <tr key={part.id} className="transition-colors hover:bg-slate-700/30">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-white">{part.name}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-400">{part.code}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-400">
                      {part.box?.name ?? 'Sin caja'}
                    </td>
                    <td
                      className={`px-6 py-4 font-semibold ${
                        part.quantity <= part.minStock
                          ? 'text-amber-400'
                          : 'text-emerald-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {part.quantity}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelectedPart(toFormValues(part));
                          setIsModalOpen(true);
                        }}
                        className="font-medium text-brand-400 transition-colors hover:text-brand-300"
                      >
                        Editar
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <PartFormModal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        part={selectedPart}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        onSaved={() => {
          void loadParts();
        }}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/Inventory/PartFormModal.tsx

import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';

interface InventoryBox {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

export interface PartFormValues {
  id?: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  quantity: number;
  boxId: number;
  minStock: number;
  keywords: string[];
}

interface PartFormModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  part?: PartFormValues | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
}

const emptyForm: PartFormValues = {
  name: '',
  code: '',
  quantity: 0,
  boxId: 0,
  minStock: 1,
  keywords: [],
};

export default function PartFormModal({
  isOpen,
  part,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}: PartFormModalProps) {
  const [boxes, setBoxes] = useState<InventoryBox[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<PartFormValues>(emptyForm);
  const [keywordsText, setKeywordsText] = useState('');
  const [isLoadingBoxes, setIsLoadingBoxes] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      return;
    }

    setForm(part ?? emptyForm);
    setKeywordsText(part?.keywords.join(', ') ?? '');

    const loadBoxes = async () => {
      setIsLoadingBoxes(true);
      try {
        const response = await api.get<InventoryBox[]>('/inventory/boxes');
        setBoxes(response.data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al cargar las cajas', error);
        toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las cajas disponibles.');
      } finally {
        setIsLoadingBoxes(false);
      }
    };

    void loadBoxes();
  }, [isOpen, part]);

  if (!isOpen) {
    return null;
  }

  const updateField = <K extends keyof PartFormValues>(
    field: K,
    value: PartFormValues[K],
  ) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      code: form.code.trim(),
      quantity: form.quantity,
      boxId: form.boxId,
      minStock: form.minStock,
      keywords: keywordsText
        .split(',')
        .map((keyword) => keyword.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    };

    try {
      if (part?.id) {
        await api.put(`/inventory/parts/${part.id}`, payload);
        toast.success('Pieza actualizada correctamente.');
      } else {
        await api.post('/inventory/parts', payload);
        toast.success('Pieza creada correctamente.');
      }

      onSaved();
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al guardar la pieza', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo guardar la pieza.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/70 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="part-form-title"
    >
      <div className="max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-2xl overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 shadow-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-700 px-6 py-4">
          <h2 id="part-form-title" className="text-xl font-bold text-white">
            {part ? 'Editar pieza' : 'Nueva pieza'}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="rounded-lg p-2 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-700 hover:text-white"
            aria-label="Cerrar modal"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-5 p-6">
          <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Nombre
              <input
                required
                maxLength={150}
                value={form.name}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('name', event.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2.5 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Código
              <input
                required
                maxLength={50}
                value={form.code}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('code', event.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2.5 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Cantidad
              <input
                required
                min={0}
                type="number"
                value={form.quantity}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('quantity', Number(event.target.value))}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2.5 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Stock mínimo
              <input
                required
                min={0}
                type="number"
                value={form.minStock}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('minStock', Number(event.target.value))}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2.5 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300 sm:col-span-2">
              Caja
              <select
                required
                value={form.boxId || ''}
                disabled={isLoadingBoxes}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('boxId', Number(event.target.value))}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2.5 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500"
              >
                <option value="" disabled>
                  {isLoadingBoxes ? 'Cargando cajas...' : 'Selecciona una caja'}
                </option>
                {boxes.map((box) => (
                  <option key={box.id} value={box.id}>
                    {box.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300 sm:col-span-2">
              Keywords
              <input
                value={keywordsText}
                onChange={(event) => setKeywordsText(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="filtro, aceite, motor"
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2.5 text-white outline-none placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:border-brand-500"
              />
              <span className="block text-xs text-slate-500">
                Separa las palabras clave con comas.
              </span>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-slate-700 pt-5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-700"
            >
              Cancelar
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || isLoadingBoxes}
              className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? 'Guardando...' : 'Guardar pieza'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/Suppliers/SuppliersList.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, PackageCheck, Truck } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';

interface Supplier { id: number; name: string; email?: string; phone?: string }
interface LowStockPart { id: number; name: string; code: string; quantity: number; minStock: number }

export default function SuppliersList() {
  const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState<Supplier[]>([]);
  const [lowStock, setLowStock] = useState<LowStockPart[]>([]);
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [supplierResponse, stockResponse] = await Promise.all([
        api.get<Supplier[]>('/suppliers'),
        api.get<LowStockPart[]>('/suppliers/low-stock'),
      ]);
      setSuppliers(supplierResponse.data);
      setLowStock(stockResponse.data);
      if (!supplierId && supplierResponse.data[0]) setSupplierId(String(supplierResponse.data[0].id));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cargar abastecimiento', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo cargar la información de proveedores.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, []);

  const requestRestock = async (part: LowStockPart) => {
    if (!supplierId) {
      toast.error('Selecciona un proveedor.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.post('/suppliers/purchase-orders', {
        number: `AUTO-${part.code}-${Date.now()}`,
        supplierId: Number(supplierId),
        items: [{ partId: part.id, quantity: Math.max(part.minStock * 2 - part.quantity, 1) }],
      });
      toast.success(`Reposición solicitada para ${part.name}.`);
      setLowStock((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== part.id));
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo registrar la reposición.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-3"><div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400"><Truck size={24} /></div><div><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Proveedores y abastecimiento</h2><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Solicita reposiciones cuando el stock esté bajo.</p></div></header>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60 p-5"><label className="mb-2 block text-sm text-slate-400">Proveedor para nuevas solicitudes</label><select value={supplierId} onChange={(event) => setSupplierId(event.target.value)} className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white">{suppliers.map((supplier) => <option key={supplier.id} value={supplier.id}>{supplier.name}</option>)}</select></div>
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-slate-800/60">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-700 p-5 text-amber-400"><AlertTriangle size={20} /><h3 className="font-semibold">Alertas de stock mínimo</h3></div>
        {loading ? <p className="p-6 text-slate-400">Cargando alertas...</p> : lowStock.length === 0 ? <p className="p-6 text-emerald-400">No hay piezas bajo el mínimo.</p> : <div className="divide-y divide-slate-700">{lowStock.map((part) => <div key={part.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"><div><p className="font-medium text-white">{part.name}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{part.code} · Stock: <span className="text-amber-400">{part.quantity}</span> / mínimo {part.minStock}</p></div><button type="button" onClick={() => void requestRestock(part)} className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600"><PackageCheck size={17} /> Solicitar reposición</button></div>)}</div>}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/DataTable.tsx
================
import { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, Eye, Inbox, Pencil, RotateCw, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface Column<T> {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  render: (row: T) => ReactNode;
  /** Oculta la columna en pantallas pequeñas (< md). */
  hideOnMobile?: boolean;
  align?: 'left' | 'right';
}

interface DataTableProps<T extends { id: number }> {
  columns: Column<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  emptyMessage: string;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onView?: (row: T) => void;
  onEdit?: (row: T) => void;
  onDelete?: (row: T) => void;
}

const SKELETON_ROWS = 5;

function cellClass(column: { hideOnMobile?: boolean; align?: 'left' | 'right' }): string {
  return [
    'px-4 py-3 sm:px-6',
    column.hideOnMobile ? 'hidden md:table-cell' : '',
    column.align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : 'text-left',
  ].join(' ');
}

const actionButton =
  'rounded-lg p-2 text-slate-400 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-500';

export default function DataTable<T extends { id: number }>({
  columns,
  rows,
  isLoading,
  error,
  emptyMessage,
  onRetry,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}: DataTableProps<T>) {
  const hasActions = Boolean(onView || onEdit || onDelete);

  if (error && !isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 p-10 text-center">
        <AlertCircle className="text-red-400" size={28} />
        <p className="text-slate-300">{error}</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-700/50"
        >
          <RotateCw size={16} /> Reintentar
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
      <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-slate-700 text-sm">
        <thead className="bg-slate-800 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
          <tr>
            {columns.map((column) => (
              <th key={column.key} scope="col" className={`${cellClass(column)} font-semibold`}>
                {column.header}
              </th>
            ))}
            {hasActions && (
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold sm:px-6">
                <span className="sr-only">Acciones</span>
              </th>
            )}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/80" aria-busy={isLoading}>
          {isLoading &&
            Array.from({ length: SKELETON_ROWS }, (_, index) => (
              <tr key={index} className="animate-pulse">
                {columns.map((column) => (
                  <td key={column.key} className={cellClass(column)}>
                    <div className="h-4 w-3/4 rounded bg-slate-700/60" />
                  </td>
                ))}
                {hasActions && (
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
                    <div className="ml-auto h-4 w-16 rounded bg-slate-700/60" />
                  </td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}

          {!isLoading && rows.length === 0 && (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={columns.length + (hasActions ? 1 : 0)} className="px-6 py-12">
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 text-slate-400">
                  <Inbox size={28} />
                  <p>{emptyMessage}</p>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}

          {!isLoading &&
            rows.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.id} className="text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700/20">
                {columns.map((column) => (
                  <td key={column.key} className={cellClass(column)}>
                    {column.render(row)}
                  </td>
                ))}
                {hasActions && (
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2 text-right sm:px-6">
                    {onView && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title="Ver detalles"
                        aria-label="Ver detalles"
                        onClick={() => onView(row)}
                        className={`${actionButton} hover:bg-slate-700/60 hover:text-white`}
                      >
                        <Eye size={17} />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {onEdit && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title="Editar"
                        aria-label="Editar"
                        onClick={() => onEdit(row)}
                        className={`${actionButton} hover:bg-brand-500/10 hover:text-brand-400`}
                      >
                        <Pencil size={17} />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {onDelete && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title="Eliminar"
                        aria-label="Eliminar"
                        onClick={() => onDelete(row)}
                        className={`${actionButton} hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400`}
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={17} />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/ResourceListPage.tsx
================
import { ReactNode, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Plus, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import DataTable, { Column } from './DataTable';

interface ResourceListPageProps<T extends { id: number }> {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  /** Nombre singular del registro, usado en mensajes ("vehículo"). */
  entityLabel: string;
  /** Debe ser una referencia estable (p. ej. `vehiclesApi.list`). */
  fetchAll: () => Promise<T[]>;
  columns: Column<T>[];
  emptyMessage: string;
  getRowLabel: (row: T) => string;
  /** Solo se pasa si el rol actual puede eliminar (el backend exige GERENTE). */
  onDelete?: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
  canCreate?: boolean;
  canEdit?: boolean;
  /** Contenido extra sobre el encabezado (p. ej. pestañas de vista). */
  toolbar?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Página de listado CRUD: encabezado + "Nuevo Registro" + tabla con carga,
 * error, vacío y acciones. Los formularios de creación/edición llegarán en la
 * siguiente fase; por ahora esas acciones solo registran en consola.
 */
export default function ResourceListPage<T extends { id: number }>({
  title,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  entityLabel,
  fetchAll,
  columns,
  emptyMessage,
  getRowLabel,
  onDelete,
  canCreate = true,
  canEdit = true,
  toolbar,
}: ResourceListPageProps<T>) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<T[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const latestRequest = useRef(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++latestRequest.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await fetchAll();
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setRows(data);
    } catch (loadError) {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) {
        setError(getApiErrorMessage(loadError, `No se pudo cargar el listado de ${title.toLowerCase()}.`));
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fetchAll, title]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    // Invalida respuestas en vuelo al desmontar.
    return () => {
      latestRequest.current += 1;
    };
  }, [load]);

  const handleDelete = async (row: T) => {
    if (!onDelete) return;
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `¿Eliminar ${entityLabel} "${getRowLabel(row)}"? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;
    try {
      await onDelete(row.id);
      setRows((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== row.id));
      toast.success(`Se eliminó ${entityLabel} "${getRowLabel(row)}".`);
    } catch (deleteError) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(deleteError, `No se pudo eliminar ${entityLabel}.`));
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      {toolbar}

      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400">
            <Icon size={24} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{title}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
              {description}
              {!isLoading && !error && (
                <span className="text-slate-500"> · {rows.length} registros</span>
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {canCreate && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => console.log('Abrir modal de creación')}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-300"
          >
            <Plus size={18} /> Nuevo Registro
          </button>
        )}
      </header>

      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60">
        <DataTable
          columns={columns}
          rows={rows}
          isLoading={isLoading}
          error={error}
          emptyMessage={emptyMessage}
          onRetry={() => void load()}
          onView={(row) => console.log('Ver detalles', row)}
          onEdit={canEdit ? (row) => console.log('Abrir modal de edición', row) : undefined}
          onDelete={onDelete ? (row) => void handleDelete(row) : undefined}
        />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx

export type BadgeTone = 'neutral' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'brand';

const toneClasses: Record<BadgeTone, string> = {
  neutral: 'bg-slate-700/50 text-slate-300 border-slate-600',
  info: 'bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-300 border-sky-500/30',
  warning: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30',
  success: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30',
  danger: 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-300 border-red-500/30',
  brand: 'bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-300 border-brand-500/30',
};

interface StatusBadgeProps {
  label: string;
  tone?: BadgeTone;
}

export default function StatusBadge({ label, tone = 'neutral' }: StatusBadgeProps) {
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${toneClasses[tone]}`}
    >
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/ViewTabs.tsx
================
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ViewTab<TKey extends string> {
  key: TKey;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
}

interface ViewTabsProps<TKey extends string> {
  tabs: ViewTab<TKey>[];
  active: TKey;
  onChange: (key: TKey) => void;
}

/** Alterna entre el listado CRUD y una vista operativa existente del módulo. */
export default function ViewTabs<TKey extends string>({ tabs, active, onChange }: ViewTabsProps<TKey>) {
  return (
    <div role="tablist" className="inline-flex rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60 p-1">
      {tabs.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
        <button
          key={key}
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={active === key}
          onClick={() => onChange(key)}
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
            active === key ? 'bg-brand-500 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <Icon size={16} /> {label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/Users/UsersList.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Plus, ShieldCheck, Users, X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';
import { Role, useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

interface ManagedUser {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  isActive: boolean;
}

const roles: Role[] = ['GERENTE', 'MECANICO', 'CLIENTE'];

export default function UsersList() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<ManagedUser[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', email: '', password: '', role: 'CLIENTE' as Role });

  const loadUsers = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get<ManagedUser[]>('/auth/users');
      setUsers(response.data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cargar usuarios', error);
      toast.error('No se pudieron cargar los usuarios.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.role === 'GERENTE') void loadUsers();
  }, [user?.role]);

  if (user?.role !== 'GERENTE') {
    return <p className="text-slate-400">No tienes permisos para administrar usuarios.</p>;
  }

  const createUser = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/auth/admin/create', form);
      toast.success('Usuario creado correctamente.');
      setForm({ name: '', email: '', password: '', role: 'CLIENTE' });
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await loadUsers();
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo crear el usuario.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (managedUser: ManagedUser) => {
    try {
      await api.patch(`/auth/users/${managedUser.id}/toggle`, { isActive: !managedUser.isActive });
      setUsers((current) =>
        current.map((item) => item.id === managedUser.id ? { ...item, isActive: !item.isActive } : item),
      );
      toast.success(managedUser.isActive ? 'Acceso desactivado.' : 'Acceso activado.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cambiar acceso', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo cambiar el acceso.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400"><Users size={24} /></div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Usuarios</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Administra personal, clientes y accesos.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600">
          <Plus size={18} /> Nuevo usuario
        </button>
      </header>

      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60">
        {isLoading ? <p className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">Cargando usuarios...</p> : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-slate-700 text-left">
              <thead className="bg-slate-800 text-xs uppercase text-slate-400"><tr><th className="px-6 py-4">Usuario</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Rol</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Estado</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Acción</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/80">
                {users.map((managedUser) => (
                  <tr key={managedUser.id} className="hover:bg-slate-700/20">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4"><div className="font-medium text-white">{managedUser.name}</div><div className="text-sm text-slate-400">{managedUser.email}</div></td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-300">{managedUser.role}</td>
                    <td className={`px-6 py-4 ${managedUser.isActive ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><ShieldCheck size={16} />{managedUser.isActive ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo'}</span></td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4"><button type="button" onClick={() => void toggleActive(managedUser)} className="text-sm font-medium text-brand-400 hover:text-brand-300">{managedUser.isActive ? 'Desactivar' : 'Activar'}</button></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/80 p-4">
          <form onSubmit={createUser} className="w-full max-w-lg space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between"><h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Crear usuario</h3><button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} aria-label="Cerrar"><X /></button></div>
            {(['name', 'email', 'password'] as const).map((field) => (
              <input key={field} required value={form[field]} type={field === 'password' ? 'password' : field === 'email' ? 'email' : 'text'} placeholder={field === 'name' ? 'Nombre completo' : field === 'email' ? 'Correo electrónico' : 'Contraseña'} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, [field]: event.target.value })} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500" />
            ))}
            <select value={form.role} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, role: event.target.value as Role })} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500">
              {roles.map((role) => <option key={role} value={role}>{role}</option>)}
            </select>
            <button disabled={saving} className="w-full rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600 disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? 'Guardando...' : 'Crear usuario'}</button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/Users/UsersManagement.tsx
